message.name:
Holes with features opposite the current cutting plane may be excluded.You have two options to include these holes.
 - Toggle the Flip Hole Direction icon to reverse the cut direction.
 - Enable Multi-Axis Machining. This will allow you to cut it from the opposite side. Opposite side cutting requires multi-axis (3+2) machining capability to rotate the part.

locale.message:
具有与当前切削平面处于相对位置的特征的孔可能会被排除。您可以使用以下两个选项来包含这些孔。

 - 启用“多轴加工”。这将允许您从对侧进行切削。对侧切削需要多轴(3+2)加工功能才能旋转零件。

A cluster is a continuous area identified as needing support, as defined by an overhang angle. The walls can be featureless or use a patterned styling. Use this structure type with another to enhance the support of a part.

locale.message: 簇是标识为需要支撑的连续区域，由悬垂角度定义。壁可以是无特征的，也可以使用阵列样式。将此结构类型与其他结构类型结合使用可增强零件的支撑。

message.name: A common use case is to machine parts with pockets or bosses that have a positive, negative, or variable draft angle, for example aerospace parts.

locale.message: 一个常见的用例是加工具有正、负或可变拔模斜度的挖槽或凸柱的零件，例如航空航天零件。

message.name: A conventional roughing strategy for clearing large quantities of material effectively. The part is cleared layer by layer with smooth offset contours maintaining climb milling throughout the operation.

locale.message: 用于有效加工大量材料的传统粗加工策略。零件通过平滑的偏移轮廓(保持整个操作过程中顺铣)逐层加工。

message.name: A document used to store CAM toolpaths

locale.message: 用于存储 CAM 刀具路径的文档

message.name: A Face operation removes all material from top of stock to top of model.

locale.message: 面加工操作会将材料从毛坯顶部移除至模型顶部。

message.name: A finishing strategy that allows you to machine along contours with the center of the tool. The provided contours are always projected onto the surface and so do not have to be on the actual surface.

locale.message: 可以使用刀具中心沿着轮廓加工的精加工策略。所提供的轮廓始终投影至曲面，因此无需直接位于实际的曲面上。

message.name: A finishing strategy, which follows the isocurves of a surface, to machine parts with curved surfaces. The machining passes and points of the toolpath are evenly spaced to provide consistent cutting motion over free-form shapes.

locale.message: 一种精加工策略，遵循曲面的等位曲线，用于加工具有曲面的零件。加工路径和刀具路径点均匀隔开，以便在自由造型的形状上提供一致的切削运动。

message.name: A group of surfaces which can be gouge checked in the same manner as the swarf surfaces.

locale.message: 可以按照与刀具侧刃加工曲面相同的方式进行过切检查的一组曲面。

message.name: A hole that is trimmed by more than the given shortfall will be flagged as partially machined.

locale.message: 修整超过给定缺口的孔将被标记为部分加工。

message.name: A layer handle could not be created.
A loop handle could not be created.
A loop handle could not be released.
A machine must contain a head or turret, and a table or spindle.

locale.message: 机床必须包含头部或刀塔以及工作台或主轴。

message.name: A machine supporting Tool Control Point (TCP) programming, usually does not require setting the Inverse time or Degrees per minute feedrates.

locale.message: 支持刀具控制点(TCP)编程的机床通常不需要设置逆向时间或每分钟度数进给速率。

message.name: A mesh body has been filtered out of collision checking.

locale.message: 网格实体已从碰撞检查中滤出。

message.name: A mesh body was not considered for automatic hole detection.

locale.message: 未考虑将网格实体用于自动孔检测。

message.name: A model could not be sliced.

locale.message: 具有给定名称的模型不存在。

message.name: A multi-axis finishing strategy that lets you machine steep walls on parts that are machined most efficiently when using the 4th machine axis.

locale.message: 一种多轴精加工策略，允许您在使用第 4 加工轴时加工以最高效率加工的零件上的陡峭壁。

message.name: A multi-axis machining strategy that lets you machine along and around a rotating axis. Rotary Parallel can be used for parts that are machined most efficiently when utilizing the 4th machine axis.

locale.message: 多轴加工策略，允许您沿旋转轴和绕旋转轴进行加工。旋转平行可用于在使用第 4 个机床轴时最高效加工的零件。

message.name: A multi-axis roughing strategy that lets you clear large quantities of material on parts that are machined most efficiently when using the 4th machine axis.

locale.message: 一种多轴粗加工策略，允许您在使用第 4 加工轴时清除以最高效率加工的零件上的大量材料。

message.name: A multi-axis strategy for machining with the side of the tool. This strategy supports both machining from contours only and from surfaces. When machining from contours only, you are required to manually synchronize the contours. Swarf supports several different cutting modes that control how to machine down the sides.

locale.message: 一种采用刀具的侧刃进行加工的多轴加工策略。该加工策略支持沿轮廓线和曲面加工。仅沿轮廓加工时，需要手动同步轮廓。刀具侧刃加工支持多种切屑模式来控制如何向下加工侧面。

message.name: A multi-axis strategy for machining with the tip of the tool along a given contact curve. By default the tool is normal to the surface, but lead/lag and sideways tilt can be applied, when desired, to control the contact point on the tool. The strategy allows center, left, and right compensation.

locale.message: 一种采用刀尖沿指定接触曲线进行加工的多轴加工策略。默认情况下，刀具会和曲面垂直，但是在需要时可以应用前倾/后倾角度来控制刀具的接触点。此加工策略还支持左、中和右的刀补。

message.name: A multi-axis strategy for machining with the tip of the tool over an entire surface. By default the tool is normal to the surface, but lead/lag and sideways tilt can be applied, when desired, to control the contact point on the tool.

locale.message: 使用刀具的刀尖对整个曲面进行加工的一种多轴加工策略。默认情况下，刀具垂直于曲面，但是仍可根据需要应用前倾/后倾，以控制刀具上的接触点。

message.name: A multi-axis strategy that machines straight-sided walls with the side of the tool. You can machine walls accurately with a large stepover, which reduces the number of passes required and reduces cycle time.

locale.message: 一种多轴加工策略，利用刀具的侧面加工直边壁。您可以使用较大的步距精确加工壁，这样可减少所需的加工路径数并缩短周期时间。

message.name: A newer version of the machine connector is now available.

locale.message: 现在提供了更高版本的机床连接器。

message.name: A numeric value must be entered.
A parameter name is a text string assigned to the parameter in the format used by the algorithms that calculate expressions.

locale.message: 参数名称是以计算表达式的算法使用的格式指定给参数的文本字符串。

message.name: A plunge rate is the speed at which the tool is driven down into the material when starting a cut. It varies depending on the tool and material. Plunging too fast may damage the tip of the cutter.

locale.message: 下切速率是指开始切削时刀具向下推入材料的速度。它随刀具和材料而变化。下切过快可能会损坏刀尖。

message.name: A print setting is a grouping of material-specific parameters, such as layer height, that you associate with an additive machine and it defines how a part is additively manufactured. The Print Setting Library lets you copy a standard print setting to a local or cloud folder, where it can then be edited as needed.

locale.message: 打印设置是一组特定于材料且与增材制造机床关联的参数(例如层高)，它定义了零件的增材制造方式。“打印设置库”用于将标准打印设置复制到本地或云文件夹，然后可以根据需要在其中编辑它。

message.name: A required tool was not found in the template.

locale.message: 在模板中未找到所需的刀具。

message.name: A roughing strategy available for clearing large quantities of material effectively. It is unique in that it guarantees a maximum tool load at all stages of the machining cycle, and makes it possible to cut deep and with the flank of the tool without risk of breakage.

locale.message: 一种粗加工策略，可用于有效地切削大量材料。该方法的独特性在于，它会保证加工循环中的所有阶段都达到最大刀具负载，并且可以利用刀具的侧面进行深度切削，而没有断刀的风险。

message.name: A script error occurred during calculation.

locale.message: 计算期间发生了脚本错误。

message.name: A setup can contain only one part alignment. To edit the existing part alignment, in the Browser, double-click the Part Alignment node to enter the contextual environment.

locale.message: 一个设置只能包含一个零件对齐。若要编辑现有零件对齐，请在浏览器中双击“零件对齐”节点以进入上下文环境。

message.name: A threshold angle determines the boundary between steep and shallow areas. Passes in steep areas and shallow areas can overlap a distance to achieve a better surface finish. In shallow areas, Parallel passes are side-by-side whereas Scallop passes are offset inwards.

locale.message: 阈值角度确定陡峭面区域和浅平面区域之间的边界。陡峭面区域和浅平面区域中的加工路径可以重叠一段距离以获得更好的曲面光洁度。在浅平面区域中，平行加工路径是并行的，而环绕等距加工路径会向内偏移。

message.name: A tool call, '%1', needs an operation after it because it is set to call the tool for the next operation.

locale.message: 刀具调用“%1”之后需要一个操作，因为它被设置为为下一个操作调用刀具。

message.name:
A tool change is needed but has not been instructed, resulting
in an inaccurate simulation of the tool change.
Contact the creator of the post configuration (.cps) file to
ensure it includes the necessary tool-change instruction.

locale.message:
需要换刀，但未指示换刀，
从而导致换刀仿真不准确。
请与后处理配置(.cps)文件的创建者联系，
确保其包含必要的换刀指令。

message.name: A tool is mounted onto a station using a tool block.

locale.message: 刀具是使用刀架装配到工位上的。

message.name: A tool must be selected in order to suggest feeds and speeds values.

locale.message: 必须选择刀具才能建议进给量和速度值。

message.name: A valid hole signature cannot have two consecutive flat segments.

locale.message: 有效的孔签名不能具有两个连续的平坦段。

message.name: A valid trim boundary has not been defined.

locale.message: 未定义有效的修整边界。

message.name: A widely used finishing strategy, the passes are parallel in the XY-plane and follow the surface in the Z-direction. You can choose the angle as well as the stepover in the horizontal direction. The passes can be linked in a zigzag pattern, unidirectional, or split in down or up milling sections.

locale.message: 一种使用广泛的精加工策略，加工路径在 XY 平面平行，且在 Z 方向沿着曲面。可选择角度以及水平方向上的步距。加工路径可以按照双向样式、单向方向进行连接，也可以在向下或向上铣削截面中进行拆分。

message.name: Ability to reduce the amplitude of vibrations

locale.message: 当特征超出角度公差时控制器要执行的动作。

message.name: Action to be carried out by the controller.
Add an extra final axial cut at a reduced stepdown.

message.name: Add capping surface for the holes.
Add comments to be shown when measuring current item.

locale.message: 添加要在测量当前项目时显示的注释。

message.name: Add passes after the machining of the end drive curve.

locale.message: 在加工末端驱动曲线之后添加加工路径。

message.name: Add passes before the machining of the start drive curve.

locale.message: 在加工始端驱动曲线之前添加加工路径。

message.name: Add stock to sides and top-bottom

locale.message: 将毛坯添加至侧面和顶部、底部

message.name: Add tabs in the toolpath to provide fixturing of the workpiece. Commonly used on routers.

locale.message: 在刀具路径中添加夹持凸台来紧固工件。常用于雕刻机。

message.name: Add the selected item(s) to a new folder

locale.message: 将选定项目添加到新文件夹

message.name: Add-in kernel could not be found at %1.

locale.message: 在 %1 中找不到附加模块内核。
其他 G 代码设置

message.name: Adds a head item to the kinematics tree. The item represents the aspect of the machine that holds the tool used for cutting during milling operations. Typically, a head holds a single tool, but this can be changed for another. Milling and mill-turn machines can have one head.

locale.message: 将头部项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示在铣削操作期间固定住用于切削的刀具的机床部件。通常，头部固定住单个刀具，但这个可以换成另一个。铣削和铣车机床可以具有一个头部。

message.name: Adds a linear axis (XYZ) to the kinematics tree. A linear axis represents a moveable aspect of the machine along the X, Y, or Z direction.

locale.message: 将线性轴(XYZ)添加到运动树状图。线性轴表示沿 X、Y 或 Z 方向的机床可移动部件。

message.name: Adds a main spindle item to the kinematics tree. The item represents the aspect of the machine that holds the part. Typically, a main spindle is used for holding the part during turning operations. Lathes and turn-mill machines can have a main spindle.

locale.message: 将主轴项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示固定住零件的机床部件。通常，主轴用于在车削操作期间固定住零件。车床和车铣机床可以具有主轴。

message.name: Adds a rotary axis (ABC) to the kinematics tree. A rotary axis represents a moveable aspect of the machine around a linear axis.

locale.message: 将旋转轴(ABC)添加到运动树状图。旋转轴表示绕线性轴的机床可移动部件。

message.name: Adds a static item to the kinematics tree. The item represents an aspect of the machine that does not move, such as the housing or the base.

locale.message: 将静态项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示不移动的机床部件，如外壳或底座。

message.name: Adds a subspindle item to the kinematics tree. The item represents the aspect of the machine that holds the part. Typically, a subspindle is used for part handling during turning operations. Lathes and turn-mill machines can have a subspindle.

locale.message: 将副主轴项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示机床上固定住零件的部位。通常，副主轴用于车削操作期间的零件搬运。车床和车铣机床可以具有副主轴。

message.name: Adds a table item to the kinematics tree. The item represents the aspect of the machine that holds the part. Milling and mill-turn machines can have a table.

locale.message: 将工作台项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示固定住零件的机床部件。铣削和铣车机床可以具有工作台。

message.name: Adds a turret item to the kinematics tree. The item represents the aspect of the machine that holds the tools used for cutting during turning operations. Typically, a turret holds multiple tools and rotates to position the correct tool near the part. Lathes and turn-mill machines can have one turret.

locale.message: 将刀塔项目添加到运动树状图。该项目表示在车削操作期间固定住用于切削的刀具的机床部件。通常，刀塔固定住多个刀具，并通过旋转将正确的刀具定位在零件附近。车床和车铣机床可以具有一个刀塔。

message.name: Adds all the setups and operations from designs you've inserted into the current document. When added, you can adjust, suppress, simulate, and post process the setups and operations.

locale.message: 添加已插入当前文档的设计中的所有设置和操作。添加后，您可以调整、抑制、仿真和后处理设置和操作。

message.name: Adds all the setups and operations in this inserted design. When added, you can adjust, suppress, simulate, and post process the setups and operations.

locale.message: 添加此已插入设计中的所有设置和操作。添加后，您可以调整、抑制、仿真和后处理设置和作。

message.name: Adds another extruder to this printer.

locale.message: 将另一个挤出机添加到此打印机。

message.name: Adds another laser to this printer.

locale.message: 将另一个激光器添加到此打印机。

message.name: Adds extra checks to mesh handling that ensures valid mesh geometries. \nWARNING: This will cause performance issues and should only be enabled as a last resort if instabilities occurs when using In-Process Stock.

locale.message: 为网格处理添加额外的检查以确保有效的网格形状。\n警告: 这会导致性能问题，只有在使用“加工中的毛坯”时出现不稳定的情况才能启用，作为最后的一种解决办法。

message.name: Adds operations to the NC output that are machine dependent.

locale.message: 向 NC 输出添加与机床相关的操作。

message.name: Adds this template to the Favorites folder

locale.message: 将此模板添加到“收藏夹”文件夹

message.name: Adjust the angle within the defined range for the axis or modify the axis limits in the machine definition's kinematics.

locale.message: 在定义的范围内调整轴的角度或在机床定义的运动设置中修改轴限制。

message.name: Adjust the Z axis spindle orientation of the machine model to ensure it aligns with the Z axis of the coordinate system. This alignment helps maintain consistency between the machine model and the coordinate system for accurate representation and simulation.

locale.message: 调整机床模型的 Z 轴主轴朝向，确保它与坐标系的 Z 轴对齐。这种对齐有助于保持机床模型和坐标系之间的一致性，以实现准确的表示和仿真。

message.name: Adjust various settings of the machine definition, such as its kinematics, to match the specific capabilities of your CNC machine. By editing the machine definition, you can ensure that the generated NC code and simulation accurately reflect the behavior and capabilities of your physical CNC machine.

locale.message: 调整机床定义的各种设置(如其运动)，使其与 CNC 机床的特定功能匹配。通过编辑机床定义，您可以确保生成的 NC 代码和仿真准确反映物理 CNC 机床的行为和功能。

message.name: After you clear the cache, the IPS needs to be regenerated for all operations in all documents. If Automatic In-Process Stock Generation is on, the IPS for each operation is automatically generated.

locale.message: 清除缓存后，需要为所有文档中的所有操作重新生成 IPS。如果“自动生成加工中的毛坯”处于启用状态，系统会自动为每个操作生成 IPS。

locale.message: 将 CNC 机床原点与设计对齐，以便缩短设置时间、提高精度并最大限度减少加工错误。

message.name: All the parameters that are currently set in this operation will be used as the default parameters for future operations of this type.\n\nYou won't be able to revert to any previously set default parameters for this operation.

locale.message: 当前在此操作中设置的所有参数将用作以后此类型的操作的默认参数。\n\n您将无法恢复为之前为此操作设置的任何默认参数。

message.name: Allow inspection points to be freely placed on cylinder surface.

locale.message: 允许检查点自由放置在圆柱面上。

locale.message: 允许从该库中的所有文件夹中选择模板。

locale.message: 允许指定毛坯绕其旋转的轴。

允许沿 X 轴平移

message.name: Allows edges to be machined at angles other than 45 degrees.

locale.message: 允许以 45 度以外的角度加工边。

message.name: Allows the retract and rewind to occur at a rapid (non-cutting) move instead of at the limits of the rotary axis when possible.

locale.message: 在可能的情况下，允许退刀和回放以快速(非切削)移动方式执行，而非在旋转轴极限位置时进行。

message.name: Allows the tool to plunge outside the stock. Disable this parameter to force ramping in stock.

locale.message: 允许刀具沿毛坯外部下刀。禁用此参数，可以强制在毛坯上斜插。

message.name: Allows the tool to stay down without retracting when the rotary axes are repositioned.

locale.message: 允许刀具在旋转轴重新定位时保持向下，无需退刀。

message.name: Also output finishing as part of the canned cycle.

locale.message: 也将精加工输出为固定循环的一部分。

locale.message: 交错支撑顶层和底层填充角度

locale.message: 或者，您可以保护刀具路径，以便 Fusion 不会重新生成它。若要执行此操作，请在浏览器中的刀具路径上单击鼠标右键，然后选择“保护”。

message.name: Alternatively, you can protect the toolpath so Fusion will not regenerate it. To do this, right-click the toolpath in the Browser and select Protect.

locale.message: 或者，您可以保护刀具路径，以便 Fusion 不会重新生成它。若要执行此操作，请在浏览器中的刀具路径上单击鼠标右键，然后选择“保护”。

message.name: Alternatively, you can protect the toolpaths so Fusion will not regenerate them. To do this, right-click the toolpaths in the Browser and select Protect.

locale.message: 或者，您可以保护刀具路径，以便 Fusion 不会重新生成它们。若要执行此操作，请在浏览器中的刀具路径上单击鼠标右键，然后选择“保护”。

message.name: Although this strategy can be used to finish an entire part, it is most commonly used to machine rest areas of a work piece, following a combination of Contour and Parallel passes.

locale.message: 尽管该加工策略可用于精加工整个零件，但它通常用于在组合使用轮廓加工路径和平行加工路径后加工工件的残料区域。

locale.message: 在本会话期间始终执行此操作

locale.message: 必须选择增材制造机床才能进行增材制造操作。

locale.message: 必须为增材操作选择增材打印设置。

message.name: An EBPA file defines the parameters that specify how parts get manufactured. An EPBA file might be provided to you by Autodesk, or you can create an EBPA file using Autodesk Advanced Toolpath Utility for Netfabb.

locale.message: EBPA 文件定义用于指定零件制造方式的参数。Autodesk 可能会为您提供 EPBA 文件，您也可以使用 Autodesk Advanced Toolpath Utility for Netfabb 创建 EBPA 文件。

message.name: An error occurred when processing the machine tool spindle for collision checking. You may be able to obtain a result if machine tool spindle collision checking is turned off.

locale.message: 由增材流程放置的轨迹的导入可视化。

An unexpected error occurred. %1 will be closed now.

locale.message: 发生了意外错误。%1现在将关闭。

message.name:
An unexpected issue interrupted the stock calculation process, preventing the stock on the canvas from updating.

This can sometimes be because of problems with the in-process stock (IPS) mesh. In Preferences > General > Manufacture, enable In-Process Stock - Mesh Check Safety, then try again.

If the error continues, report it.

locale.message:
某个意外问题中断了毛坯计算过程，从而阻止了更新画布上的毛坯。

这有时是由于加工中的毛坯(IPS)网格问题所致。请在首选项 > 通用 > 制造中，启用加工中的毛坯 - 网格检查安全，然后重试。

如果错误仍然存在，请报告该错误。

message.name:
An unexpected issue interrupted the verification process before completion.

This can sometimes be because of problems with the in-process stock (IPS) mesh. In Preferences > General > Manufacture, enable In-Process Stock - Mesh Check Safety, then try again.

If the error continues, report it.

locale.message:
某个意外问题中断了验证过程，使其无法完成。

这有时是由于加工中的毛坯(IPS)网格问题所致。请在首选项 > 通用 > 制造中，启用加工中的毛坯 - 网格检查安全，然后重试。

如果错误仍然存在，请报告该错误。

The bars most often start from the build platform, branch out, and support the selected areas. A layer-by-layer animation of the support can be viewed when you simulate the additive toolpath.

message.name: Based on the calculated part alignment, the work coordinate system (WCS) on the machine controller gets updated for the remaining operations in the setup. Live connection requires an installed Machine Connector application and a connection to a machine tool. Normally, this is a physical connection using an ethernet or serial cable, but some machine tools also support a wireless network connection.

locale.message: 根据计算的零件对齐，机床控制器上的工件坐标系(WCS)将针对设置中的其余操作进行更新。实时连接需要已安装的机床连接器应用程序以及与机床的连接。通常，这是使用以太网或串行电缆的物理连接，但某些机床也支持无线网络连接。

message.name: Based on the simulated results, the original shape of the part is automatically modified to correct for the warpage. When additively manufacturing the compensated part, the part then warps to the originally desired shape.

Can't create an attach frame. An attach frame is where you connect something to a part. For example, defining an attach frame to connect a tool to the machine's head.
The attach frames' axes must be perpendicular. Specify the location of its center point and the direction of its Z and X axes.

locale.message:
无法创建附着结构件。附着结构件是您将某个物体连接到零件的位置。例如，定义附着结构件以将刀具连接到机床的头部。
附着结构件的轴必须垂直。指定其中心点的位置及其 Z 轴和 X 轴的方向。

message.name:
Cannot load machine model.

An unknown error occurred meaning the simulation-ready machine is selected in the setup, but its machine model cannot be loaded. When simulating toolpaths, the machine will not be displayed.

Try selecting the machine again. In the Setup dialog, click Select to open the Machine Library, then import and select the machine configuration (*.machine) file.

If this does not work, use the Machine Builder contextual environment to link the model with the machine again.

locale.message:
无法加载机床模型。

出现未知错误，意味着已在设置中选定了做好仿真准备的机床，但无法加载其机床模型。对刀具路径进行仿真时，将不会显示该机床。

请尝试再次选择该机床。在“设置”对话框中，单击“选择”以打开机床库，然后导入该机床配置(*.machine)文件并将其选中。

如果这不起作用，请使用“机床生成器”上下文环境再次将模型与机床连接起来。

message.name: Create multiple NC Program groups for different postprocessing situations.

locale.message: 为不同的后处理情况创建多个 NC 程序组。

message.name: Creates a 3+2 roughing strategy for removing large amounts of material using multiple tool orientations.

locale.message: 创建 3+2 粗加工策略，以使用多个刀具朝向去除大量材料。

message.name: Creates a 3D Manufacturing Format (3MF) file which contains a color-coded displacement representation of the warped part.

locale.message: 创建一个包含翘曲零件颜色编码位移表示的 3D 制造格式(3MF)文件。

message.name: Creates a CLD (Cutter Location Data) toolpath in the project.

locale.message: 在项目中创建 CLD (刀具位置数据)刀具路径。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation intended for steep areas similar to the Contour strategy. However, this strategy ramps down walls rather than machines with a constant Z, as is the case for Contour.

locale.message: 创建一个用于陡峭面区域且与轮廓加工策略类似的精加工策略。但是，该加工策略沿着壁向下斜坡加工，而不像轮廓加工策略使用恒定的 Z 值加工。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation that automatically detects all the flat areas of a part that are perpendicular to the tool orientation. Machine the flats with a type of toolpath that resembles either the Pocket or Parallel strategy.

locale.message: 创建可自动检测垂直于刀具朝向的零件的所有平坦区域的精加工操作。使用类似于挖槽或平行策略的刀具路径类型加工平坦面。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation that automatically detects vertical walls.

locale.message: 创建可自动检测垂直壁的精加工操作。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation that machines steep areas using Contour passes and shallow areas using Parallel or Scallop passes.

locale.message: 创建一个精加工操作，其使用轮廓加工路径加工陡峭面区域，且使用平行或环绕等距加工路径加工浅平面区域。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation to machine any remaining stock that is left over by previous tools.

locale.message: 创建精加工操作以加工由先前刀具留下的任何剩余毛坯。

message.name: Creates a finishing operation to machine freeform surfaces and undercuts.

locale.message: 创建精加工操作以加工自由造型曲面和倒扣面。

message.name: Creates a finishing or semi-finishing operation for steep areas, such as vertical walls.

locale.message: 为陡峭区域(例如垂直壁)创建精加工或半精加工操作。

message.name: Creates a finishing strategy to deburr external corners that are sharp or rounded.

locale.message: 创建精加工策略，以便对外部锐角或外部圆角去毛刺。

message.name: Creates a finishing strategy to machine geometry such as curved floors or walls of pockets.

locale.message: 创建精加工策略以加工形状，例如弯曲楼板或挖槽壁。

message.name: Creates a list of inspection operations based on existing PMI objects that can be measured.

locale.message: 基于可测量的现有 PMI 对象创建检查操作列表。

message.name: Creates a list of items you want to inspect using a manual measuring instrument, such as a caliper, micrometer, or height gauge.

locale.message: 创建要使用手动测量仪表(例如卡尺、千分尺或测高计)进行检查的项目列表。

message.name: Creates a mesh body that automatically compensates for the displacement predicted in the solved Process Simulation study, and closes the Results contextual environment

locale.message: 创建网格实体，使其自动补偿在求解的过程仿真分析中预测的位移，并关闭“结果”上下文环境

message.name: Creates a multi-axis roughing operation to clear out areas such as pockets with floors that are not entirely flat.

locale.message: 创建多轴粗加工操作以清除区域，如底面不完全平坦的挖槽。

message.name: Creates a probing operation to locate stock and features and update the work coordinate system (WCS) using probing cycles (macros) on the CNC machine.

locale.message: 创建探测操作以定位毛坯和特征，并使用 CNC 机床上的探测循环(宏)更新工件坐标系(WCS)。

message.name: Creates a probing operation to measure and verify critical features, such as holes, bosses, surfaces, walls, channels, and corners, using probing cycle (macros) on the CNC machine. It also enables the fitting and inspection of geometric features, like circles and planes, from probed points without using probing cycles.

locale.message: 创建探测操作以使用 CNC 机床上的探测循环(宏)测量和验证关键特征，如孔、凸柱、曲面、壁、通道和转角。它还允许从探测点拟合和检查几何特征(如圆和平面)，而不使用探测循环。

message.name: Creates a probing operation to perform surface inspection of complex, free-form parts through a user-defined probe path.

locale.message: 创建探测操作以通过用户定义的探测路径对复杂的自由造型零件执行曲面检查。

message.name: Creates a Process Simulation study for a single body.A Process Simulation study uses FEA (finite element analysis) to predict a part's behavior during the additive manufacturing process, such as the extent of any warpage. Multiple studies can be created in a setup.

locale.message: 为单个实体创建过程仿真分析。过程仿真分析使用 FEA (有限元分析)来预测增材制造过程中的零件行为，如任何翘曲的范围。可以在设置中创建多个分析。

message.name: Creates a report of the currently selected inspection results. The report includes the data plus a snapshot of the current image in the canvas.

locale.message: 创建当前选定检查结果的报告。报告包含数据以及画布中当前图像的快照。

message.name: Creates a roughing operation that uses a more optimized toolpath that avoids abrupt direction changes.

locale.message: 创建使用更加优化的刀具路径且可避免突然改变方向的粗加工操作。

message.name: Creates a roughing operation that uses toolpaths parallel to selected geometry.

locale.message: 创建使用与所选形状平行的刀具路径的粗加工操作。

message.name: Creates a setup for inspection using a CMM (coordinate measuring machine), such as a portable arm.

locale.message: 使用 CMM (坐标测量机) (例如便携式臂)为检查创建设置。

message.name: Creates a setup with an additive toolpath from a GCODE file.

locale.message: 从 GCODE 文件创建具有增材刀具路径的设置。

message.name: Creates a spiral toolpath from a given center point, generating a constant contact as it machines within a given boundary. Ideally suited for use on round shallow parts using tool contact angles up to 40 degrees, in conjunction with Contour passes for the more vertical faces.

locale.message: 根据给定的中心点创建环切刀具路径，在给定边界范围内加工时保持恒定的接触。用于使用 40 度以内刀具接触角加工圆形浅平面零件(组合使用轮廓加工路径加工较为垂直的面)的理想选择。

message.name: Creates a spiraling helical cut, for thread milling the selected faces.

locale.message: 创建缓和曲线螺旋切削，用于对选定面进行螺纹铣削。

message.name: Creates a toolpath stream for subtractive simulation

locale.message: 为减材仿真创建刀具路径流

message.name: Creates a toolpath that traces a sketch profile.

locale.message: 创建跟踪草图轮廓的刀具路径。

message.name: Creates an additive toolpath for building features using multi-axis deposition technologies. For example, DED (directed energy deposition).

locale.message: 创建增材刀具路径以使用多轴沉积技术构建特征。例如，DED (定向能量沉积)。

message.name: Creates an operation for inspecting the surface of a part using a probe.

locale.message: 创建操作以使用探头检查零件的曲面。

message.name: Creates an STL file of the inverse-warped part. This compensates for the displacement predicted by the solved Process Simulation study.

locale.message: 创建反向翘曲零件的 STL 文件。这将补偿已求解过程仿真分析预测的位移。

message.name: Creates an STL file of the warped part as predicted by the solved Process Simulation study.

locale.message: 根据已求解过程仿真分析的预测，创建翘曲零件的 STL 文件。

message.name: Creates circular cuts at multiple heights along the selected faces, that includes a lead in/lead out move.

locale.message: 沿选定面在多个高度处创建圆形切削，包括导入/导出移动。
创建选定零部件的副本。

message.name: Creates machine-specific NC code for the setup, NC program, or individual operations selected in the Browser.

locale.message: 为在浏览器中选择的设置、NC 程序或单个操作创建特定于机床的 NC 代码。

message.name:
Creates mesh bodies of support structures, enabling independent repositioning and manufacturing of supports from the main part.

The mesh bodies are added to the manufacturing model. Splitting supports is useful for working with setter supports, as it allows you to print the supports separately from the main parts. This is important because setter supports often require separate processing, such as placement in a furnace for sintering.

locale.message:
创建支撑结构的网格实体，这样能够独立于主零件来重新定位和制造支撑。

这些网格实体将添加到制造模型。分割支撑对于使用定型支撑很有用，因为它允许您独立于主零件来打印支撑。这非常重要，因为定型支撑通常需要单独处理，如放入炉中烧结。

message.name: Creates NC code for all the operations in the setup.

locale.message: 为设置中的所有操作创建 NC 代码。

message.name: Creates NC code for the Inspect Surface operations in the setup, whose results will be used to calculate the part alignment.

locale.message: 为设置中的“检查表面”操作创建 NC 代码，其结果将用于计算零件对齐。

message.name: Creates NC code for the remaining operations in the setup with the part alignment applied.

locale.message: 为设置中的其余操作创建 NC 代码，并应用零件对齐。

message.name: Creates passes at a constant distance from one another by offsetting them inwards along the surface. The passes follow sloping and vertical walls to maintain the stepover.

locale.message: 创建保持恒定距离的刀具路径(通过设置沿曲面向内的偏移)。加工路径沿着斜坡和垂直壁，以保持步距。

message.name: Creates setups from all the envelopes in the arrangement. One setup is created for each envelope. The stock matches the size of the envelope and the WCS is placed in the bottom-left corner of the stock.

locale.message: 从排列中的所有封套创建设置。将为每个封套创建一个设置。毛坯与封套的大小匹配，并且 WCS 放置在毛坯的左下角。

message.name: Creates single or multiple finishing cuts to machine grooves.

locale.message: 创建单个或多个精加工切削以加工凹槽。

message.name: Creates toolpaths along internal corners and fillets with small radii, removing material that no other tool can reach.

locale.message: 创建沿着内部转角和小半径圆角的刀具路径，移除其他刀具不能达到的材料。

locale.message: 创建基于 2D 轮廓的刀具路径。轮廓可以是开放或闭合的，且 Z 层可以不同，但每个轮廓都是平整的(2D)。

message.name: Define the components that represent the linear, rotary, and static aspects of your CNC machine. Specify the attachment point of the tool to the spindle and the position of the part on the table. This assignment of components and attachment points ensures an accurate representation of your CNC machine's behavior during simulation.

locale.message: 定义表示 CNC 机床的线性、旋转和静态方面的零部件。指定刀具到主轴的附着点以及零件在工作台上的位置。这种零部件和附着点指定可确保在仿真期间准确表示 CNC 机床的行为。

message.name: Defines a distance (in millimeters), measured from the surface of the probe's stylus tip. CAD surfaces inside this distance are guaranteed to be considered for projection.

locale.message: 确定距离(从探头的探针针尖所在的曲面开始测量，以毫米为单位)。此距离内的 CAD 曲面保证可用于投影。

locale.message: 定义放置零件的精确度。\n\n注意: 计算越精确，速度越慢。

message.name: Defines if the printer has an extruder fan. If enabled, fan commands will be outputted in the print file. If disabled, fan commands will not be outputted in the print file, even if the fan is enabled in the print settings.

message.name:
Defines the origin of the machine model's coordinate system.

Model Origin uses the origin of the model orientation for the current part. Select Origin lets you click a vertex or edge on the machine model's geometry to set the origin.

message.name:
Displays key data about your print, including estimated printing time and layer count.

Gain valuable insights into your prints to help optimize your additive manufacturing process. For FFF prints, access additional details, such as, filament usage, cost estimation, and energy consumption. For MPBF prints, find out exposure time, recoating time, and recoating time per layer.

locale.message:
显示有关打印的关键数据，包括估计打印时间和层数。

在打印方面获得有价值的见解，以帮助优化增材制造流程。对于 FFF 打印，可访问其他详细信息，如打印丝使用量、成本估算和能耗。对于 MPBF 打印，可了解曝光时间、铺粉时间和每层铺粉时间。

message.name:
Displays key information on the number of arranged components, the solid volume of the components, and the build height of the tallest component.

Also calculates the arrangement density as a percentage, based on the available build volume and build height of the components. The statistics do not consider support structures or components that have lattice structures created using Volumetric Lattice.

locale.message:
显示有关排列零部件数、零部件实体体积和最高零部件构建高度的关键信息。

还根据零部件的可用构建体积和构建高度计算排列密度(以百分比形式表示)。统计信息不考虑支持结构或具有使用体积晶格创建的晶格结构的零部件。

message.name: Displays points that are above the specified form tolerance. These points indicate areas where the geometric feature deviates positively from the acceptable form.

message.name: Displays points that are below the specified form tolerance. These points indicate areas where the geometric feature deviates negatively from the acceptable form.

locale.message: 显示低于指定形状公差的点。这些点表示几何特征负偏离可接受形状的区域。

locale.message: 显示在指定形状公差范围内的点。这些点表示几何特征符合可接受形状的区域。

message.name: Displays the form tolerance limits of each geometric feature. Form tolerance defines the allowable deviation of a geometric feature from its ideal form.

locale.message: 显示每个几何特征的形状公差限值。形状公差定义了几何特征与其理想形状的允许偏差。

locale.message: 启用此设置，使切削深度相等。

message.name: Enable this setting to force even stepdowns. By default, the maximum stepdown is used to ensure as much as possible of the flute is used. However, this means that the last steps are adjusted to fit the machining depths and hence result in uneven stepdowns.

locale.message: 启用该设置，使下刀步距更平均。根据默认设置，最大下刀步距用于确保刀刃长度被尽可能多地使用。然而，这意味着后续的铣削操作会根据加工深度进行调整，因此导致下刀步距不平均。

message.name: Enable this setting to start pocket clearing with a slot along its middle before continuing with spiral motion towards the pocket wall. This feature can be used to reduce linking motion at corners for some pockets.

locale.message: 启用该设置，开始使用挖槽中间的窄槽进行挖槽清洁，然后继续对挖槽壁进行螺旋铣削。该功能可以减少某些挖槽的转角处的关联运动。

message.name: Enable this to produce offset for shallow regions from surrounding steep regions.

locale.message: 启用该选项以使用偏移模型，否则将使用“偏移所有”。

locale.message: 启用该项可激活强制按切削方向进行简单排序，而非按最短距离排序。在某些情况下，可以使用该功能来避免在加工零件上留下痕迹。然而，额外的连接运动会增加加工时间。

message.name: Following a recent fix, the turning tool's Compensation point might have changed if set to Tip Tangent. Edit the tool and verify the position of the tip tangent, then regenerate the operation.

message.name: For 2D arrangements, the panel displays the actual and remnant efficiency, and the total remnant area. For 3D arrangements, the density by volume and by height, and the components volume are displayed.

locale.message: 对于二维排列，面板会显示实际和余量效率以及总余量面积。对于三维排列，将显示按体积和高度的密度以及零部件体积。

message.name: For CNC machines, you can link a post processor and a machine model to a machine definition. Linking a post processor optimizes the generated NC code, while linking a machine model enables visualization during simulation. The Machine Builder, accessible when editing a machine definition, allows you to assign components, adjust axis directions, and verify movements by jogging axes.

locale.message: 对于 CNC 机床，您可以将后处理器和机床模型链接到机床定义。链接后处理器可优化生成的 NC 代码，而链接机床模型可在仿真期间实现可视化。使用机床生成器(在编辑机床定义时可访问)，您可以指定零部件、调整轴方向以及通过微调轴来验证移动。

message.name: For example, if the feedrate equals 2, the move should be completed within 0.5 minute. Used by some post processors to program the feedrate for a 4th or 5th axis when there are multiple rotary axes.

locale.message: 例如，如果进给速率等于 2，则移动应在 0.5 分钟内完成。当存在多个旋转轴时，某些后处理器使用它来对第 4 轴或第 5 轴的进给速率进行编程。

message.name: For example, if the feedrate equals 2, the move should be completed within 0.5 second. Used by some post processors to program the feedrate for a 4th or 5th axis, when there are multiple rotary axes.

locale.message: 例如，如果进给速率等于 2，则移动应在 0.5 秒内完成。当存在多个旋转轴时，某些后处理器使用它来对第 4 轴或第 5 轴的进给速率进行编程。

message.name: For example, you can set a different home position for the subspindle to ensure appropriate tool clearances when it is being used. This customization helps optimize machining operations by minimizing the risk of collisions.

locale.message: 例如，您可以为副主轴设置不同的原点位置，以确保在使用刀具时间隙合适。这种自定义设置通过最大限度地降低碰撞风险来帮助优化加工操作。

message.name: For more control, you have the choice of either a continuous spiral, circular or line style toolpath. The circular and line style toolpaths can be contained by specifying angular limits around the rotary axis.

locale.message: 为了进行更多控制，您可以选择连续的环切形、圆形或直线形刀具路径。通过绕旋转轴指定角度限制可以包含圆形和直线形刀具路径。

message.name: For multi-axis machining, radial and axial stock to leave must be equal.

locale.message: 对于多轴加工，径向和轴向加工余量必须相等。

message.name: For multiple pockets, floor surfaces need to be connected tangentially. You can use construction geometry to create a surface that spans all the pockets you need to clear.

locale.message: 对于多个挖槽，底面曲面需要切向连接。您可以使用构造形状来创建一个跨越需要清除的所有挖槽的曲面。

message.name: For printers with multiple extruder, this defines the distance between each extruder in the X axis. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 对于有多个挤出机的打印机，这定义了 X 轴上每个挤出机之间的距离。该值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: For printers with multiple extruder, this defines the distance between each extruder in the Y axis. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 对于有多个挤出机的打印机，这定义了 Y 轴上每个挤出机之间的距离。该值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: For printers with multiple extruder, this defines the distance between each extruder in the Z axis. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 对于有多个挤出机的打印机，这定义了 Z 轴上每个挤出机之间的距离。该值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: For printers with multiple extruder, this defines the distance between each extruder. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 对于有多个挤出机的打印机，这定义了每个挤出机之间的距离。该值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: For results visible on the canvas, displays the measured points where the probe inspected the geometric features. You can then use the filters to choose which points are shown based on whether they are in or out of form tolerance.

locale.message: 对于画布上可见的结果，显示探头检测几何特征的测量点。然后，您可以使用过滤器，根据点是否在形状公差范围内来选择显示哪些点。

message.name: From Coordinate means the axis moves in the direction of the selected Coordinate axis. Along XYZ means the axis moves in the X, Y, or Z direction. Around XYZ means the axis rotates around the X, Y, or Z axis. Custom lets you define a specific direction using a vector.

locale.message: “从坐标”表示轴沿选定坐标轴的方向移动。“沿 XYZ”表示轴沿 X、Y 或 Z 方向移动。“绕 XYZ”表示轴绕 X、Y 或 Z 轴旋转。“自定义”允许使用矢量定义特定方向。

message.name: Generate 3- or 5-axis toolpaths. 5-axis toolpaths consist of cutting moves that use 3+2 axes and transition moves that use simultaneous 5-axis motion. You can manually specify the 3+2 orientations, or use an automatic method based on tilting values, or a combination of both.

locale.message: 生成 3 轴或 5 轴刀具路径。5 轴刀具路径由使用 3+2 轴的切削移动和使用同时 5 轴运动的过渡移动组成。您可以手动指定 3+2 方向，或使用基于倾斜值的自动方法，也可以将两种方法结合使用。

message.name: Generate 3- or 5-axis toolpaths. For 5-axis toolpaths, specify the 3+2 orientations to use to machine the part. Cutting moves occur in 3+2 axes and transition moves use simultaneous 5-axis motion.

locale.message: 生成 3 轴或 5 轴刀具路径。对于 5 轴刀具路径，指定用于加工零件的 3+2 朝向。切削移动发生在 3+2 轴上，过渡移动使用 5 轴联动运动。

message.name: If the machine connector application or Shop Floor Connector is running on a separate computer to Fusion, make sure that there is a network connection between them and the connections are correctly configured.

locale.message: 如果机床连接器应用程序或车间连接器与 Fusion 运行于不同的计算机上，请确保它们之间存在网络连接并且已正确配置连接。

message.name: If the Regenerate on Rewind option is deselected, there may be a mismatch between the stock on the canvas and the current point in the simulation.

locale.message: 如果取消选择了“回放时重生成”选项，则画布上的毛坯与仿真中的当前点之间可能存在不匹配。

message.name: If true, overlapping pockets will be merged into one single pocket

locale.message: 如果为 true，则重叠的挖槽将合并为一个挖槽

message.name: If using a 3 Planes alignment type, make sure that the three planes are non-parallel.

locale.message: 如果使用“3 个平面”对齐类型，请确保这三个平面不平行。

message.name: If using a connected measuring instrument that outputs text, the instrument sends the measurement data directly to Fusion. If using a simpler, more traditional instrument, you can type the measured values using the computer's keyboard. After recording the manual inspection, optionally save the results as an inspection report.

locale.message: 如果使用输出文本的连接测量仪表，该仪表会将测量数据直接发送到 Fusion。如果使用更简单、更传统的仪表，则可以使用计算机的键盘键入测量值。记录手动检查后，可选择将结果保存为检查报告。

message.name: If using a Plane and 2 Circles alignment type, make sure that the two circles are parallel to the plane.

locale.message: 如果使用“平面和 2 个圆”对齐类型，请确保这两个圆与平面平行。

message.name: If using a USB to Serial adapter, in the Device Manager, select the Ports (COM & LPT) option to find the port number.

locale.message: 如果使用 USB 转串行适配器，请在设备管理器中选择“端口(COM 和 LPT)”选项以查找端口号。

message.name: If using a wireless connection, make sure that the machine tool is switched on and connected to the network, and then try again.

locale.message: 如果使用无线连接，请确保机床已开启并已连接到网络，然后重试。

message.name: If you choose Cancel, you can add the data later. In the Browser, right-click the inserted design (external component) and choose Insert Manufacturing Data.

locale.message: 如果选择“取消”，则可以稍后添加数据。在浏览器中，在插入的设计(外部零部件)上单击鼠标右键，然后选择“插入制造数据”。

message.name: If you experience a problem, visit the forums to get help from the Autodesk Community or contact a provider on the Services Marketplace.

locale.message: 如果您遇到问题，请访问“Autodesk 社区”论坛以获取帮助，或与“服务市场”中的提供商联系。

message.name: If you haven't inserted any designs that include manufacturing data, or if the setups and operations are already added, this option has no effect.

locale.message: 如果您未插入任何包含制造数据的设计，或者如果已添加设置和操作，则此选项无效。

message.name: If you took snapshots of the model's position and orientation when creating the manual inspection, select the check box to update the canvas.

locale.message: 如果在创建手动检查时拍摄了模型的位置和方向的快照，请选中该复选框以更新画布。

message.name: If you want to remove all associativity with the original design, break the link from within the Design workspace.

locale.message: 如果要移除与原始设计的所有关联，请在“设计”工作空间中断开链接。

message.name: If your machine has a staging function for the tool changer, turn it on. For machines without staging tool change capabilities, turn it off.

locale.message: 如果机床具有换刀装置的作业台功能，请将其启用。对于没有作业台换刀功能的机床，请将其禁用。

message.name: If your machine has an automatic tool changer, turn the option on. For machines with manual tool change capabilities, turn it off.

locale.message: 如果机床具有自动换刀装置，请启用该选项。对于具有手动换刀功能的机床，请将其禁用。

message.name: Imports a JSON file that overwrites the parameter values in the General tab of the current print setting, and creates a body preset.

locale.message: 导入覆盖当前打印设置的“常规”选项卡中参数值的 JSON 文件，并创建实体预设。

message.name: Imports a machine-generated results file and calculates the part alignment.

locale.message: 导入机床生成的结果文件并计算零件对齐。

message.name: Imports a machine-generated results file containing the measurements taken by a probe on a machine tool.

locale.message: 导入机床生成的结果文件，其中包含由机床上的探头测量得到的值。

message.name: Imports an EBPA file that overwrites the list of parameters, and their values, in the General tab, and in the body presets, of the current print setting.

locale.message: 导入覆盖当前打印设置的“常规”选项卡和实体预设中参数列表及其值的 EBPA 文件。

message.name: Imports default settings for all the toolpath strategies in the Manufacture workspace.

locale.message: 在“制造”工作空间中导入所有刀具路径策略的默认设置。

message.name: Improve machining time by using a variable stepdown to remove the maximum amount of stock for each stepdown. Improve cutting conditions by offsetting the tool to cut with the leading edge of the tool instead of its center point.

locale.message: 通过使用可变下刀步距来移除每个下刀步距的最大毛坯量，从而缩短加工时间。通过偏移刀具以使用刀具的前缘(而不是中心点)进行切削，从而改善切削条件。

message.name: Improves toolpath calculation when undercuts are present in the stock, resulting in reduced air cutting. This can often improve machining time significantly.

locale.message: 改进了毛坯中存在倒扣面时的刀具路径计算，从而减少空切。这通常能够大大缩短加工时间。

message.name: In future updates, these improvements will be Fusion's default behavior and you will no longer be able to change settings here.

locale.message: 在将来的更新中，这些改进将是 Fusion 的默认行为，您将无法再在此处更改设置。

message.name: In order to use Duplicate, a Manufacturing Model must be selected in the setup.

locale.message: 若要使用“创建副本”，必须在设置中选择制造模型。

message.name: In order to use Fill Build Volume, a Manufacturing Model must be selected in the setup.

locale.message: 若要使用“填充构建体积”，必须在设置中选择制造模型。

message.name: In the Browser, double-click the active setup to open the Setup dialog, then click Select to choose a different machine from the Machine Library. Choose a machine with Machine Connector capability, and then try again.

locale.message: 在浏览器中，双击激活的设置以打开“设置”对话框，然后单击“选择”从机床库中选择其他机床。请选择具有机床连接器功能的机床，然后重试。

message.name: In the Browser, double-click the active setup to open the Setup dialog, then click Select to choose a machine from the Machine Library. Choose a machine with Machine Connector capability, and then try again.

locale.message: 在浏览器中，双击激活的设置以打开“设置”对话框，然后单击“选择”从机床库中选择机床。请选择具有机床连接器功能的机床，然后重试。

message.name: In the Browser, select a toolpath, then use the Replace Tool modification. A dialog appears to let you replace the tool, and if required, type any notes.

locale.message: 在浏览器中，选择刀具路径，然后使用“替换刀具”修改。系统将显示一个对话框，用于替换刀具，以及根据需要键入任何注释。

message.name: In the Browser, under the Results node, select a results folder or an individual set of results. You can create reports for imported machine-generated inspection results or for recorded manual inspections.

locale.message: 在浏览器中的“结果”节点下，选择一个结果文件夹或一组单独的结果。您可以为导入的机床生成的检查结果创建报告，也可以为记录的手动检查创建报告。

message.name: In the canvas, select one or more features. The features' nominal measurements are displayed as labels. Supported features currently include holes and bosses (for measuring diameters) and two parallel surfaces (for measuring distances).

locale.message: 在画布中，选择一个或多个特征。特征的公称测量值显示为标签。支持的特征当前包括孔和凸柱(用于测量直径)和两个平行曲面(用于测量距离)。

message.name: In the canvas, select the bodies that were probed.

locale.message: 在画布中，选择探测到的实体。

message.name: In the Model list, select a machine model for this machine definition that is located in your current hub, and then try again.

locale.message: 在“模型”列表中，为位于当前中心中的此机床定义选择机床模型，然后重试。

Machining defines a linear or rotary axis, often for the head, turret, or main spindle, used for machining operations.
Prompt for manual positioning defines an axis where you must manually position the axis to continue machining.
Performing supportive operations defines an axis used for positioning the part or tool outside of cutting moves, or for part transfer, often using the linear axis for the sub spindle.

加工通常为机头、刀塔或主轴定义用于加工操作的线性或旋转轴。
提示手动定位定义您必须手动定位轴以继续加工的轴。

message.name: Opens a contextual environment where you link a machine in the Machine Library to a machine model, which is then displayed during toolpath simulation.\n\nOpen a design file containing a machine model. message.name: Part alignment helps to reduce alignment imprecisions, ensuring operations in a setup are accurate. It is ideal for parts with complex, free-form surfaces, such as those made by casting, forging, and additive manufacturing. Available only for machine tools with milling and inspection capabilities.

locale.message: 零件对齐有助于降低对齐误差，确保设置中的操作准确。它非常适用于具有复杂自由形状曲面的零件，例如通过铸造、锻造和增材制造所制造的零件。仅适用于具有铣削和检查功能的机床。

locale.message: 选择样例机床，然后将其拖动或复制到“我的机床”中的库。这可以是本地库或云库。

message.name: Select a sketch profile to use for collision avoidance, overriding the automatically generated profile from the solid model.

locale.message: 选择要用于碰撞避让的草图轮廓，它将覆盖从实体模型自动生成的轮廓。

message.name: Select a tool from the document.
Select components to be removed from the active setup.

locale.message: 选择要从活动设置中移除的组件。

message.name: Select components to represent the part

locale.message: 选择零部件以表示零件

message.name: Select cylindrical or conical faces to machine. Heights and depths are detected from the selected geometry. Cylinders, cones, circular cavities and bosses can all be machined in a single operation.

locale.message: 选择要加工的圆柱面或圆锥面。从选定的几何图元中检测高度和深度。圆柱、圆锥、圆形型腔和凸柱都可以通过单次操作进行加工。

message.name: Select directory to export JSON file

locale.message: 选择要导出 JSON 文件的目录

message.name: Select Edit if you want to modify the linked geometry selection. This affects all operations that use the same selection.\n\nSelect Break Link if you want to create a copy of this geometry selection that you can edit without affecting the original geometry selection.

locale.message: 如果要修改链接的形状选择，请选择“编辑”。这将影响使用相同选择的所有操作。\n\n如果要此形状选择的副本，以便您可以在不影响原始形状选择的情况下进行编辑，请选择“断开链接”。

message.name: Select file to encode in base64

locale.message: 选择要在 base64 中编码的文件
选择 Fusion 中心输出文件夹

message.name:
Select if only one or all instances in the pattern should be posted.

Posting only one instance in a pattern is useful for verifying the results before posting all instances.

locale.message:
选择是仅发布阵列中的一个实例还是发布所有实例。

仅发布阵列中的一个实例对于在发布所有实例之前验证结果非常有用。

message.name: Select if you trust source of the post processor.

locale.message: 选择您是否信任后处理器的来源。
选择检查报告保存位置
选择 NC 代码输出文件夹

message.name: Select print setting to use as template

locale.message: 选择要用作模板的打印设置

message.name: Select probe type to enable tolerances.

locale.message: 选择探测类型以启用公差

message.name: Select reference operations for rest finishing

locale.message: 选择残料精加工的参考操作
选择要显示的结果类型

message.name: Select results to calculate the part alignment. Results may be selected now or at a later stage.

locale.message: 选择结果以计算零件对齐。可在现在或稍后阶段选择结果。

message.name: Select same diameter holes for drill operation.

locale.message: 选择相同直径的孔用于钻孔操作。

message.name: Select same diameter holes or bosses for probing.

locale.message: 选择相同直径的孔或凸柱以进行探测。
选择设置清单输出文件夹

message.name: Select the axis around which rotations are allowed.

locale.message: 选择允许绕其旋转的轴。

message.name: Select the milling or turning operation that machined this feature to determine tool to be updated.

locale.message: 选择加工此特征的铣削或撤销操作以确定要更新的刀具。

message.name: Select the name of the folder to add the results to an existing folder. Alternatively, select New Inspection Results to add the results to a new folder.

locale.message: 选择文件夹名称以将结果添加到现有文件夹。或者，选择“新建检查结果”将结果添加到新文件夹。

message.name: Select the normal for the trim boundary.
Select the normal for the trim plane.
Select the PMI that is used for the pmiInfo plan.

locale.message: 选择用于 pmiInfo 计划的 PMI。

message.name: Select the preset to use for the feeds and speeds of the operation.

locale.message: 选择预设以用于操作的进给量和速度。

message.name: Select the results file from Fusion Hub, or, if the file is stored locally, from your computer.

locale.message: 从 Fusion 中心中选择结果文件；如果结果文件存储在本地，则从计算机中进行选择。

message.name: Select the results file from Fusion Hub, or, if the file is stored locally, from your computer. The results are added as a node in the Browser and colored confetti, pins, or cylinders are displayed in the canvas. Analysis of the results indicate if they are in or out of tolerance.

locale.message: 从 Fusion 中心中选择结果文件；如果结果文件存储在本地，则从计算机中进行选择。结果会被添加为浏览器中的节点，并且画布中会显示彩色纸屑、图钉或圆柱体。结果分析信息指示了结果是否在公差范围内。

message.name: Select the three features that will be used for calculating the alignment.

locale.message: 选择将用于进行对齐计算的三个特征。

message.name: Select the tool axis main direction.

Selected Compensation Type isn't supported for Wrap. The existing toolpath remains usable and can be protected. Editing of the toolpath will require recalculation, which will automatically switch Wear and Inverse Wear to In Computer, and In Control to Off compensations

locale.message: 选定的补偿类型不支持环绕加工。现有刀具路径仍然可用并且可以受到保护。编辑刀具路径要求重新计算，这会自动将“磨损”和“逆向磨损”补偿模式切换为“计算机内部计算”，并将“控制器内部计算”切换为“关闭”状态

message.name: Selected face may not be safe for cutting at current tool orientation!

locale.message: 选定的面对于以当前刀具朝向进行切削可能不安全！

message.name: Selected file does not contain a valid machine configuration.

locale.message: 选定的文件不包含有效的机床配置。

message.name: Selected holes do not have matching orientation.
Selected holes do not match each other.
Selected surface cannot be machined in 4-axis mode.

locale.message: 所选曲面不能在 4 轴模式下加工。

message.name: Selecting a new signature from hole geometry will overwrite the existing components.\n\nDo you wish to proceed?

locale.message: 从孔形状中选择新签名将覆盖现有组件。\n\n是否要继续？

message.name: Selection contains components which are not part of the setup.

locale.message: 选定对象包含不属于设置的零部件。

message.name: Selection does not contain any operations.
Selects all components outside of the build volume to be removed from the active setup.

locale.message: 选择要从活动设置中移除的构建体积之外的所有组件。

message.name: Selects or deselects all items of the machine to be collision checked against the currently selected item\nin the kinematics tree. To restore the selections, choose Reset to defaults.

locale.message: 选择或取消选择要对照运动树状图中的当前选定项进行碰撞检查的\n机床的所有项。若要恢复选择，请选择“重置为默认值”。

message.name: Selects the machine in the Machine Library that you want to link to the machine model in the current design file.\n\nThe kinematics of the machine must be defined in the machine configuration.

locale.message: 在机床库中选择要链接到当前设计文件的机床模型的机床。\n\n必须在机床配置中定义机床的厚度。

message.name: Selects the sign preference for the axis.
Self intersecting model contour is supported only for 'Center' sideways compensation.

locale.message: 仅“中心”侧边补偿支持自交模型轮廓。

message.name: Set the collision handling for the toolpath.

locale.message: 设置刀具路径的碰撞处理。

message.name: Set the dimensions of the tool Head
Sets the amount of time, in seconds, that is required for a tool change.

locale.message: 设置换刀所需的时间长度(以秒为单位)。

message.name: Sets the angle of the %1 axis. Enter an angle or move the manipulator on the canvas. The machine model updates as you change the angle. Ensure that the value is within the range specified in the machine's kinematics.

locale.message: 设置 %1 轴的角度。输入一个角度或在画布上移动操纵器。机床模型会随着您改变角度而更新。确保该值在机床运动中指定的范围内。

message.name: Sets the angular distance range between the tool axis vector and the singularity point before the singularity is adjusted.

locale.message: 设置在调整奇异点之前刀具轴矢量和奇异点之间的角度距离范围。

message.name: Sets the axis offset in X direction.

locale.message: 设置 X 方向的轴偏移。

message.name: Sets the axis offset in Y direction.

locale.message: 设置 Y 方向的轴偏移。

message.name: Sets the axis offset in Z direction.

locale.message: 设置 Z 方向的轴偏移。

message.name: Sets the computer's serial port number used for the connection. Valid port numbers range from 1 to 256.

locale.message: 设置用于连接的计算机串行端口号。有效端口号的范围是从 1 到 256。

message.name: Sets the coordinate for linear and rotary axes.

locale.message: 设置线性轴和旋转轴的坐标。

message.name: Sets the corner radius of the machine's platform. The radius must not exceed half of the smaller dimension (X or Y). For example, for a 300x200mm platform, the machine radius must be 100mm or less. A value of 0 results in right-angle corners.

locale.message: 设置机床平台的转角半径。半径不得超过较小尺寸(X 或 Y)的一半。例如，对于 300x200 毫米的平台，机床半径必须小于或等于 100 毫米。值为 0 时，转角为直角。

message.name: Sets the current axis position as the maximum value that the axis can reach, measured from the zero position.

locale.message: 将当前轴位置设置为轴可以达到的最大值(从零位开始测量)。

message.name: Sets the current axis position as the minimum value that the axis can reach, measured from the zero position.

locale.message: 将当前轴位置设置为轴可以达到的最小值(从零位开始测量)。

message.name: Sets the current axis position as the new home position, measured from the zero position.

locale.message: 将当前轴位置设置为新原点位置(从零位开始测量)。

message.name: Sets the current axis position as the new tool change position, measured from the zero position.

locale.message: 将当前轴位置设置为新换刀位置(从零位开始测量)。

message.name: Sets the current axis position as the new zero position, serving as a reference for other positions.

locale.message: 将当前轴位置设置为新的零位置，用作其他位置的参考。

message.name: Sets the data transfer rate of the serial port number in bits per second.

locale.message: 设置串行端口号的数据传输速率(以位/秒为单位)。

message.name: Sets the diameter of the filament that the printer's extruder supports.

locale.message: 设置打印机的挤出机支持的打印丝直径。

message.name: Sets the diameter of the nozzle of the extruder. Tyically, extruders can have different types of nozzles and these can vary in diameter. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置挤出机喷嘴的直径。通常，挤出机可以具有不同类型的喷嘴，并且这些喷嘴的直径可以不同。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the factor to adjust the machining time for an operation to the feedrates used.

locale.message: 设置系数，以按照使用的进给速率调整操作的加工时间。

message.name: Sets the feedrate as a combination of degrees per minute and linear feed per minute. Used typically for machines that require a form of degrees per minute feedrates.

locale.message: 将进给速率设置为每分钟度数和每分钟线性进给量的组合。通常用于需要每分钟度数形式的进给速率的机床。

message.name: Sets the feedrate based on the diameter of the cutting operation and calculates the degrees of the move. Used for most rotary axes.

locale.message: 根据切削操作的直径设置进给速率并计算移动的度数。用于大多数旋转轴。

message.name: Sets the height of the build volume. This is the volume in which the additive machine can print parts. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置构建体积的高度。这是增材制造机床可打印零件的体积。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the IP address of the computer where the Machine Connector application is used.

locale.message: 设置使用机床连接器应用程序的计算机的 IP 地址。

message.name: Sets the IP address of the machine tool's controller.

locale.message: 设置机床控制器的 IP 地址。

message.name: Sets the IP address of the Shop Floor Connector.

locale.message: 设置车间连接器的 IP 地址。

message.name: Sets the length of the build volume. This is the volume in which the additive machine can print parts. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置构建体积的长度。这是增材制造机床可打印零件的体积。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the length of the retract moves along the tool axis, to perform a rewind.

locale.message: 设置沿刀具轴退刀的移动长度，以执行回放。

message.name: Sets the maximum cutting feedrate for the axis.

locale.message: 设置轴的最大切削进给速率。

message.name: Sets the maximum feedrate value that can be output for the inverse time and degrees per minute feedrates.

locale.message: 设置可针对逆向时间输出的最大进给速率值和每分钟度数进给速率。
设置最大线性进给速率。

message.name: Sets the maximum number of blocks of program code executed per number of seconds.

locale.message: 设置每秒执行的最大程序代码块数。

message.name: Sets the maximum number of revolutions per minute of the spindle during turning operations.

locale.message: 设置车削操作期间主轴的每分钟最大转数。

message.name: Sets the maximum number of revolutions per minute that the driven (live) tool can be programmed to.

locale.message: 设置可将从动(动态)刀具编程到的每分钟最大转数。

message.name: Sets the maximum number of revolutions per minute that the milling tool mounted to the head makes.

locale.message: 设置安装到机头的铣削刀具的每分钟最大转数。

message.name: Sets the maximum tool diameter that can be stored in the tool magazine.

locale.message: 设置可存储在刀具库中的最大刀具直径。

message.name: Sets the maximum tool length that can be stored in the tool magazine.

locale.message: 设置可存储在刀具库中的最大刀具长度。

message.name: Sets the minimum angular delta movement for the rotary axes before the singularity is adjusted.

locale.message: 设置在调整奇异点之前旋转轴的最小角度增量移动。

message.name: Sets the minimum distance between discrete steps along curved toolpaths. Reduce the increment for a higher-precision finish. Increase the increment for a faster but slightly less precise finish.

locale.message: 设置沿曲线刀具路径的离散步距之间的最小距离。减小增量可实现更高精度的精加工。增大增量可实现更快但略不精确的精加工。

message.name: Sets the minimum number of revolutions per minute of the spindle during turning operations.

locale.message: 设置车削操作期间主轴的每分钟最小转数。

message.name: Sets the minimum number of revolutions per minute that the driven (live) tool can be programmed to.

locale.message: 设置可将从动(动态)刀具编程到的每分钟最小转数。

message.name: Sets the minimum number of revolutions per minute that the milling tool mounted to the head makes.

locale.message: 设置安装到机头的铣削刀具的每分钟最小转数。

message.name: Sets the name of the extruder. This will be shown in the print file if the postprocessor outputs this information.

locale.message: 设置挤出机的名称。如果后处理器输出此信息，则该名称将显示在打印文件中。

message.name: Sets the name of the item in the kinematics tree. This name is used to identify the part in the Machine Library.

locale.message: 设置运动树状图中项目的名称。此名称用于标识机床库中的零件。

message.name: Sets the number of binary bits used to represent the data.

locale.message: 设置用于表示数据的二进制位数。

message.name: Sets the number of bits that indicates the end of data transmission.

locale.message: 设置指示数据传输结束的位数。

message.name: Sets the number of tool stations around the turret that have a tool mounted in place.

locale.message: 设置刀塔周围已有刀具装配到位的刀具工位数。

message.name: Sets the number of tool stations available around turret.

locale.message: 设置刀塔周围可用的刀具工位数。

message.name: Sets the offset distance of bodies from the build platform. This is useful for additive technologies where parts are not printed directly on the build platform. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置实体自构建平台的偏移距离。这对于不直接在构建平台上打印零件的增材制造技术非常有用。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the path to the folder where the Machine Connector application is located.

locale.message: 设置机床连接器应用程序所在文件夹的路径。

message.name: Sets the port number for the machine tool's controller.

locale.message: 设置机床控制器的端口号。

message.name: Sets the port number of the Machine Connector application.

locale.message: 设置机床连接器应用程序的端口号。

message.name: Sets the port number of the Shop Floor Connector.

locale.message: 设置车间连接器的端口号。

message.name: Sets the port number used by the machine tool's controller for machine data collection.

locale.message: 设置机床控制器用于收集机床数据的端口号。

message.name: Sets the pulse weight ratio for the rotary axes when DPM feedrates are output as a combination of linear and rotary movements.

locale.message: 当 DPM 进给速率作为线性移动和旋转移动的组合输出时，设置旋转轴的脉冲重量比。

message.name: Sets the rapid feedrate for the axis.

locale.message: 设置轴的快速进给速率。

message.name: Sets the safe plunge feedrate for plunge moves.

locale.message: 设置下切移动的安全下切进给速率。

message.name: Sets the safe retract feedrate for retract moves.

locale.message: 设置退刀移动的安全退刀进给速率。

message.name: Sets the time in minutes for completing a move as an inverse of the feedrate.The smaller the value, the faster the move.

locale.message: 将完成移动的时间(以分钟为单位)设置为与进给速率成反比。值越小，移动速度越快。

message.name: Sets the time in seconds for completing a move as an inverse of the feedrate. The smaller the value, the faster the move.

locale.message: 将完成移动的时间(以秒为单位)设置为与进给速率成反比。值越小，移动速度越快。

message.name: Sets the time interval between the completion of one layer and the application of the next layer of powder on the build platform. This setting affects the build-time estimation in the print statistics. Increasing the interval allows for more cooling time, while reducing it can speed up printing. However, shorter intervals may lead to excessive heat build-up, potentially causing distortion of the printed part.

locale.message: 设置在构建平台上完成一层与涂抹下一层粉末之间的时间间隔。此设置会影响打印统计信息中的构建时间估计值。增大间隔允许更多的冷却时间，而减小间隔可以加快打印速度。不过，较短的间隔可能会导致过多的热量积聚，这样可能会导致打印的零件变形。

message.name: Sets the tolerance for deciding whether to output a feedrate value or not. It helps to minimize the output of multi-axis feedrate numbers.

locale.message: 设置公差以确定是否输出进给速率值。该公差有助于最大程度减少输出的多轴进给速率数。

message.name: Sets the tolerance value for converting simultaneous multi-axis movements to linear movements when the tool axis is near a singularity.

locale.message: 设置公差值，用于在刀具轴接近奇异点时将同步多轴移动转换为线性移动。

message.name: Sets the type of interface used to mount the tool to the tool station.

locale.message: 设置用于将刀具安装到刀具工位的接口类型。

message.name: Sets the width of the build volume. This is the volume in which the additive machine can print parts. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置构建体积的宽度。这是增材制造机床可打印零件的体积。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the X-coordinate of the home positon. The home position is where the print head moves to before and after printing. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置原点位置的 X 坐标。原点位置是打印前和打印后打印头移动到的位置。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the X-coordinate of the park position. The park position is a temporary waiting position that the print head moves to mid-print when required to do so. For example, when changing between extruders. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置停放位置的 X 坐标。停放位置是打印头在打印过程中需要移动到的临时等待位置。例如，在挤出机之间切换时。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the Y-coordinate of the home positon. The home position is where the print head moves to before and after printing. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置原点位置的 Y 坐标。原点位置是打印前和打印后打印头移动到的位置。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the Y-coordinate of the park position. The park position is a temporary waiting position that the print head moves to mid-print when required to do so. For example, when changing between extruders. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置停放位置的 Y 坐标。停放位置是打印头在打印过程中需要移动到的临时等待位置。例如，在挤出机之间切换时。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the Z-coordinate of the home positon. The home position is where the print head moves to before and after printing. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置原点位置的 Z 坐标。原点位置是打印前和打印后打印头移动到的位置。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Sets the Z-coordinate of the park position. The park position is a temporary waiting position that the print head moves to mid-print when required to do so. For example, when changing between extruders. This is measured in mm.

locale.message: 设置停放位置的 Z 坐标。停放位置是打印头在打印过程中需要移动到的临时等待位置。例如，在挤出机之间切换时。此值的测量单位为毫米。

message.name: Settings for controlling pattern instances rotation.

locale.message: 用于控制阵列实例旋转的设置。

message.name: Settings related to additive functionality in the Manufacture workspace

locale.message: 与“制造”工作空间中的增材功能相关的设置

message.name: Settings related to inspection results functionality in the Manufacture workspace

locale.message: 与“制造”工作空间中检查结果功能相关的设置

message.name: Settings related to Linked CAM data.

locale.message: 与链接的 CAM 数据相关的设置。

message.name: Settings related to stock simulation and inspection.

locale.message: 与毛坯仿真和检查有关的设置。

message.name: Settings related to the in-process and remaining (rest) stock.

locale.message: 与加工中的毛坯和剩余(残料)毛坯相关的设置。

message.name: Settings related to the manufacturing model.

locale.message: 与制造模型相关的设置。

message.name: Settings related to the tool library.
Settings related to turning functionality in the Manufacture workspace

locale.message: 与“制造”工作空间中的车削功能相关的设置

message.name: Several toolpaths have invalid selections. To regenerate these toolpaths, you must first edit them and clear the invalid selections.\nAffected toolpaths:

locale.message: 有些刀具路径包含无效选择。若要重新生成这些刀具路径，必须先对其进行编辑并清除无效选择。\n受影响的刀具路径:

message.name:
Several toolpaths use preview features or features within an extension. To regenerate these toolpaths, enable the required preview features from the Preferences dialog, or pay for access to the required extension.

Alternatively, you can protect toolpaths so Fusion will not regenerate them. To do this, right-click the toolpaths in the Browser and select Protect.
Affected toolpaths:

locale.message:
有几条刀具路径使用预览功能或扩展程序中的功能。若要重新生成这些刀具路径，请从“首选项”对话框中启用所需的预览功能，或者付费访问所需的扩展程序。

或者，您可以保护刀具路径，以便 Fusion 不会重新生成它们。若要执行此操作，请在浏览器中的刀具路径上单击鼠标右键，然后选择“保护”。
受影响的刀具路径:
已检测到轴和/或夹头碰撞。

message.name: Shift the point positions along the edges of the plane.

message.name: Short tools tend to vibrate less than longer tools, providing a better surface finish. However, a short tool may not be suitable to machine an entire part because of possible collisions. A use case could be to trim and keep both parts of a toolpath, use the short tool on the toolpath that has the most coverage, and then use a longer tool on the other toolpath to machine the remainder.

locale.message: 短刀具产生的颤动往往比较长刀具要少，从而提供更好的曲面光洁度。但是，短刀具可能不适合加工整个零件，因为可能存在碰撞。使用情形可以是，要修剪并保留刀具路径的两个部分，在具有最大覆盖范围的刀具路径上使用短刀具，然后在其他刀具路径上使用较长刀具以加工其余部分。

message.name: Shows or hides the machine tool in the canvas during simulation.\n\nShow the machine to visually verify its movements. When showing the machine, use the options in the Simulate dialog to show or hide the machine's base or make the machine transparent.

locale.message: 仿真期间在画布中显示或隐藏机床。\n\n显示机床可直观地验证其移动。显示机床时，使用“仿真”对话框中的选项可显示或隐藏机架或使机床变透明。

message.name: Shows or hides the stock in the canvas during simulation.\n\nStock represents the workpiece from which a part is manufactured. When showing the stock, use the Colorization options in the Simulate dialog to differentiate stock depending on material, operation type, or tool usage, or to show if there is excess or gouged stock.

locale.message: 仿真期间在画布中显示或隐藏毛坯。\n\n毛坯表示从中制造出零件的工件。显示毛坯时，使用“仿真”对话框中的“着色”选项，可根据材料、操作类型或刀具使用情况区分毛坯，或者显示是否存在多余或过切的毛坯。

message.name: Shows or hides the toolpaths in the canvas during simulation.\n\nToolpaths consist of link moves, lead moves, cutting moves, and points. Lead moves are the entry to, and exit from, cutting moves, while link moves occur between cutting moves. Points show where each move starts and ends. When showing the toolpaths, use the options in the Simulate dialog to show or hide different move types and points.

locale.message: 仿真期间在画布中显示或隐藏刀具路径。\n\n刀具路径由连接移动、引导移动、切削移动和点组成。引导移动是指进入和退出切削移动，而连接移动发生在切削移动之间。点显示每次移动的开始和结束位置。当显示刀具路径时，使用“仿真”对话框中的选项可显示或隐藏不同的移动类型和点。

message.name: Similar to part alignment, live part alignment helps to reduce alignment imprecisions, ensuring operations in a setup are accurate. But, in addition, it also provides a quicker, more automated workflow by removing the need for a machine operator to import a machine-generated results file. Live part alignment requires a connection to a machine tool.

locale.message: 与零件对齐类似，实时零件对齐有助于降低对齐不精确性，从而确保设置中的操作准确。但此外，它还通过让机床操作员无需导入机床生成的结果文件，提供了更快且更自动化的工作流。实时零件对齐需要与机床的连接。

message.name: Similar to Spiral except that this operation generates the spiral from the selected boundary as opposed to Spiral which trims the generated passes to the machining boundary. This means that Morphed Spiral can be used for additional surfaces for which Spiral is not appropriate.

message.name: Specifies how much of the feature is constructed

Specifies how the CNC machine axes behave during rapid moves when TCP (Tool Center Point) is active, as defined in the machine's controller.

Independent Axes moves the axes independently at maximum speed, potentially resulting in different completion times for each axis. Synchronized Axes moves the axes together, completing the motion simultaneously, although the tool's tip may deviate from the direct line between the start and finish points. Tool Tip adjusts the linear axes to keep the tool's tip positioned along the direct line between the start and finish points.

locale.message:
指定当 TCP (刀具中心点)处于活动状态时(如机床的控制器中所定义) CNC 机床轴在快速移动期间的行为方式。

如果选择“独立轴”，将以最大速度独立地移动轴，可能会导致每个轴的完成时间不同。如果选择“同步轴”，会将轴一起移动，同时完成运动，不过刀尖可能会偏离起点和终点之间的直线。如果选择“刀尖”，将调整线性轴，以使刀尖沿起点和终点之间的直线定位。

message.name:
Specifies how the CNC machine axes behave during rapid moves when TCP (Tool Center Point) is inactive, as defined in the machine's controller.

Independent Axes moves the axes independently at maximum speed, potentially resulting in different completion times for each axis. Synchronized Axes moves the axes together, completing the motion simultaneously, although the tool's tip may deviate from the direct line between the start and finish points.

locale.message:
指定当 TCP (刀具中心点)处于非活动状态时(如机床的控制器中所定义) CNC 机床轴在快速移动期间的行为方式。

如果选择“独立轴”，将以最大速度独立地移动轴，可能会导致每个轴的完成时间不同。如果选择“同步轴”，会将轴一起移动，同时完成运动，不过刀尖可能会偏离起点和终点之间的直线。

locale.message: 指定在执行后处理后应在浏览器中创建 NcProgram 条目

message.name: Specifies that cavities should be machined.

Specifies that cusps left by the roughing passes should be cleared. Enable this setting to avoid the tool colliding with leftover stock after the roughing passes at walls. This is in particular relevant when using the 'Up and Down' turning mode for the following finishing passes.

locale.message: 指定应对粗加工路径留下的剩余材料进行清洁。启用此设置可避免粗加工路径碰壁后刀具与残余毛坯发生碰撞。这在对后续精加工路径使用“向上和向下”车削模式时尤为重要。

message.name: Specifies that extra passes should be generated for steep areas perpendicular to the passes.

locale.message: 指定应针对与加工路径垂直的陡峭面区域生成额外的加工路径。

message.name: Specifies that final depth should be roughed.

locale.message: 指定应对最后深度进行粗加工。

message.name: Specifies that groove suppression should be used.
Specifies that helical circular moves are allowed.

locale.message: 指定允许螺旋圆形移动。

message.name: Specifies that machine or avoid surfaces should be used.

locale.message: 指定应使用加工或避开曲面。

message.name: Specifies that machining should be done using multiple passes.

locale.message: 指定应使用多个加工路径进行加工。

message.name: Specifies that multiple threads should be machined.
Specifies that multiple threads should be output.
Specifies that passes may be split and relinked if required to avoid holder collision.

locale.message: 指定必要时可能对加工路径进行拆分和重新连接，以避免夹头碰撞。

message.name: Specifies that pecking should be used for the grooving.

locale.message: 指定开槽加工应使用啄钻方式。

message.name: Specifies that pecking should be used for the grooving. Use can use this feature to break the chips.

locale.message: 指定应将啄钻用于开槽。使用此功能可进行断屑。

message.name: Specifies that pecking should be used for the roughing. Use can use this feature to break the chips.

locale.message: 指定应将啄钻用于粗加工。使用此功能可进行断屑。

message.name: Specifies that sharp corners must be forced. Note that using a smaller tool on the machine can cause a gouge when using this feature.

locale.message: 指定必须强制生成锐角。注意，使用该功能时，若使用较小的刀具进行加工，可能导致过切。

message.name: Specifies that steps should be generated by the maximum stepover instead of the number of passes.

locale.message: 指定步进量应根据最大步距而不是加工路径的数量生成。

message.name: Specifies that the dimension is a lower limit.

locale.message: Specifies that the dimension is a lower limit.

message.name: Specifies that the dimension is an upper limit.

locale.message: Specifies that the dimension is an upper limit.

message.name: Specifies that the feed is given as feed per revolution.

locale.message: 指定进给量的给定方式为每转进给量。

message.name: Specifies that the feed should be reduced at corners.

locale.message: 指定应减小转角处的进给量。

message.name: Specifies that the feedrate should only be reduced at inner corners.

locale.message: 指定只能减小内部转角处的进给速率。

message.name: Specifies that the given lead directions are always relative to the XZ coordinate system. When disabled, the leads will be relative to the front/back cutting direction of the individual pass.

locale.message: 指定给定的引导方向总是与 XZ 坐标系相关。禁用该选项后，引导方向与单个加工路径的向前/向后切削方向相同。

message.name: Specifies that the holder of the selected tool should be used for collision checking.

locale.message: 指定应当用于碰撞检查的选定刀具的夹头。

message.name: Specifies that the holder of the selected tool should be used.

locale.message: 指定应使用所选刀具的夹头。

message.name: Specifies that the holder should be used when generating the toolpath.

locale.message: 指定生成刀具路径时应使用夹头。

message.name: Specifies that the last passes should be repeated twice.

locale.message: 指定最后一个加工路径应重复两次。

message.name: Specifies that the linear axis is physically limited to the values of the minimum and maximum positions of the axis. Expressed in millimeters or inches.

locale.message: 指定线性轴物理限制为轴的最小和最大位置值。以毫米或英寸表示。

message.name: Specifies that the machining continues from the previous setup.

locale.message: 指定继续从以前的设置进行加工。

message.name: Specifies that the machining may happen from both sides (ie. perpendicular to the cutting direction).

locale.message: 指定可从两侧进行加工(即垂直于切削方向)。

message.name: Specifies that the NC file should be opened in the editor.\nNote: If you post to Fusion Hub it also specifies whether the file will be opened in browser or not.

locale.message: 指定应在编辑器中打开 NC 文件。\n注意: 如果发布到 Fusion 中心，还会指定是否在浏览器中打开该文件。

message.name: Specifies that the passes should be ordered bottom-up.

locale.message: 指定加工路径的顺序应为从底部到顶部。

message.name: Specifies that the passes should be repeated twice.

locale.message: 指定工路径应重复两次。

message.name: Specifies that the rotary axis is not physically limited, but the output values for this axis need to be within the values in degrees defined in the minimum and maximum range.

locale.message: 指定物理限制旋转轴，但此轴的输出值必须在最小值和最大值范围中定义的度数值范围内。

message.name: Specifies that the rotary axis is physically limited to the values in degrees defined in the minimum and maximum range.

locale.message: 指定旋转轴物理限制为在最小值和最大值范围内定义的度数值。

message.name: Specifies that the shaft and/or holder of the selected tool should be used.

locale.message: 指定应使用所选刀具的轴和/或夹头。

message.name: Specifies that the shaft should be used when generating the toolpath.

locale.message: 指定生成刀具路径时应使用轴。

message.name: Specifies that the shoulder should be used when generating the toolpath.

locale.message: 指定在生成刀具路径时应使用肩部。

message.name: Specifies that the stepover should be ensured from either of the consecutive cuts instead of only being appling from the cut which confines that stepover the least. You will generally see a difference when machining open passes that are not ending close together. When enabling this setting you may get cuts that are closer than desired.

locale.message: 指定应通过任一连续切削来确保步距，而不是仅通过将该步距限制到最小的切削来应用步距。在加工不一起结束的开放加工路径时，您通常会看到差别。当启用该设置时，您可能获得比所需更紧密的切削。

message.name: Specifies that the stock should be clamped for use on the other spindle.

locale.message: 指定应夹持毛坯，用于另一主轴。

message.name: Specifies that the stock should be machined using constant surface speed.

locale.message: 指定应使用固定的表面速度加工毛坯。

message.name: Specifies that the tailstock is attached to the part.

locale.message: 指定尾座固定在零件上。

message.name: Specifies that the tool position and orientation should be adjusted after radial offset has been applied.

locale.message: 指定应用了径向偏移后，应调整刀具位置和朝向。

message.name: Specifies that the tool should follow the surface normals.

locale.message: 指定刀具应遵循曲面法线。

message.name: Specifies that the tool should follow the upper guide curve as opposed to the lower guide curve.

locale.message: 指定刀具应遵循与较低引导曲线相对的较高引导曲线。

message.name: Specifies that the tool should keep contact at corners.

locale.message: 指定刀具应在转角处保持接触。

message.name: Specifies that the tool will machine in the negative diameter.

locale.message: 指定刀具将在负直径内加工。

locale.message: 指定线性轴和此轴的输出值没有物理限制。

message.name: Specifies that there is no physical limit for the rotary axis and no limit on the output values for this axis.

locale.message: 指定旋转轴没有物理限制，并且对此轴的输出值没有限制。

message.name: Specifies that tool must be lifted against the selected model.

locale.message: 指定应基于所选模型提升刀具。

指定额外的进给量偏移。

message.name: Specifies the holder mode. The holder is ignored when don't care is selected. In trimming mode toolpath for which the holder would cause a collision with the part is discarded. In non-trimmed mode the toolpath is lifted such that the shaft and holder do not gouge the part. The final modes allow the user to automatically detect the required tool length and fail on holder collision.

locale.message: 指定夹头模式。选择了“不定义”时，忽略夹头。在修整模式中，夹头会导致与零件的碰撞的刀具路径将被弃用。在非修整模式中，会提升刀具路径，这样轴和夹头不会导致零件过切。最终模式允许用户自动检测要求的刀具长度以及夹头碰撞失败。

message.name: Specifies the minimum allowed axial engagement for the intermediate steps. This feature is commonly used to keep at least one flute constantly engaged as it turns and hence can reduce tool wear and chatter. Note that skipping intermediate steps will leave extra stock for the following semi-roughing operation.

message.name: Specifies the minimum allowed chord length for circular moves.

locale.message: 指定圆形移动的最小允许弦长。

locale.message: 指定圆形移动的最小允许半径。

message.name: Specifies the minimum allowed tilt from the selected operation tool axis.

locale.message: 指定相对于选定操作刀具轴所允许的最小倾斜。

message.name: Specifies the minimum and maximum values.

locale.message: 指定夹头和模型间的最小安全高度。需要确保安全高度大于任何加工余量。

message.name: Specifies the number of detected collisions. Depending on the toolpath being simulated is can take quite some time before the entire toolpath has been processed. As collisions are detected this will continuously be presented in the position bar at the bottom of the window. Collisions include rapid through stock and shaft and holder touching unmachined stock. Note that problems like exceeding allowed stepover and stepdowns for tools cannot be detected.

locale.message: 指定检测到的碰撞数。根据正在仿真的刀具路径，可能需要相当长的时间才能处理整个刀具路径。由于检测到碰撞，因此这将持续显示在窗口底部的位置栏中。碰撞包括快速穿过毛坯以及与未加工毛坯接触的轴和夹头。请注意，不能检测到超出刀具允许的步距和下刀步距等问题。

message.name: Specifies the number of detected collisions. Depending on the toolpath being simulated, it can take quite some time before the entire toolpath has been processed. As collisions are detected, they are presented in the position bar at the bottom of the window. Collisions include rapid movements through stock and shaft and holder touching unmachined stock. Note that problems like exceeding the allowed stepover and stepdowns for tools cannot be detected.

locale.message: 指定检测到的碰撞数。根据正在仿真的刀具路径，在处理整个刀具路径之前可能需要相当长的时间。检测到碰撞后，它们会显示在窗口底部的位置栏中。碰撞包括通过毛坯以及与未加工毛坯接触的轴和夹头的快速移动。请注意，无法检测超出允许的步距和下刀步距等问题。
