message.name: Specifies the shaft and holder mode. The shaft and holder are ignored when don't care is selected. In trimming mode toolpath for which the shaft/holder would cause a collision with the part is discarded. In non-trimmed mode the toolpath is lifted such that the shaft and holder do not gouge the part. The final modes allow the user to automatically detect the required tool length and fail on shaft/holder collision respectively.

locale.message: 指定轴和夹头模式。选择了“不定义”时，忽略轴和夹头。在修整模式中，轴/夹头会导致与零件的碰撞的刀具路径将被弃用。在非修整模式中，会提升刀具路径，这样轴和夹头不会导致零件过切。最终模式允许用户自动检测要求的刀具长度以及轴/夹头碰撞失败。

message.name: The Inspect Surface strategy requires that you manually specify inspection points on the surface of the part. By defining these inspection points, you can accurately inspect and analyze the surface deviations, helping you determine if the part is within tolerance. Additionally, it eliminates the need to move parts between the CNC machine and a separate measuring device, such as a coordinate measuring machine (CMM), helping reduce time and effort. Inspection data can be imported from a CNC machine-generated results file or imported in real-time using a live connection.

locale.message: “检查表面”策略要求您手动指定零件表面上的检查点。通过定义这些检查点，您可以精确地检查和分析表面偏差，从而帮助您确定零件是否在公差范围内。此外，它还让您不再需要在 CNC 机床和坐标测量机(CMM)等独立测量设备之间移动零件，从而帮助减少所花费的时间和精力。检查数据可以从 CNC 机床生成的结果文件导入，也可以使用实时连接实时导入。

message.name: The Probe Geometry strategy provides several benefits. When using probing macros, it enables you to update the tool wear stored in the CNC machine''s controller, compensating for tool deflection and reduced diameter, leading to improved accuracy in future machining operations. When fitting geometric features, it enables you to set point tolerances to define acceptable variations at each probe point. Additionally, you can adjust feature tolerances specific to the selected surface type, such as planar or cylindrical surfaces, ensuring precise analysis of variations in flatness, shape, position, and diameter. Inspection data can be imported from a CNC machine-generated results file or imported in real-time using a live connection.

locale.message: “探测形状”策略提供了诸多优势。当使用探测宏时，它可让您更新存储在 CNC 机床控制器中的刀具磨损数据，补偿刀具变形和减小的直径，从而提高将来加工操作的精度。当拟合几何特征时，它可让您设置点公差以定义每个探测点处可接受的变化。此外，您还可以调整特定于选定曲面类型(如平面或圆柱曲面)的特征公差，从而确保精确分析平坦度、形状、位置和直径的变化。检查数据可以从 CNC 机床生成的结果文件导入，也可以使用实时连接实时导入。

message.name: The Probe WCS strategy enables you to locate stock and identify features such as holes, bosses, surfaces, walls, channels, and corners. By performing measurements against specified tolerances, this strategy helps identify variations and enables actions based on the inspection results. It also provides the capability to update the WCS Offset defined in the setup, compensating for any deviations and improving the accuracy of future machining operations. Inspection data can be imported from a CNC machine-generated results file or imported in real-time using a live connection.

locale.message: “探测 WCS”策略可让您定位毛坯并识别特征，如孔、凸柱、曲面、壁、通道和转角。通过对照指定公差执行测量，此策略有助于识别变化并根据检查结果启用操作。此外，它还让您能够更新设置中定义的 WCS 偏移，从而补偿任何偏差并提高将来加工操作的精度。检查数据可以从 CNC 机床生成的结果文件导入，也可以使用实时连接实时导入。

message.name: The results include displacement and recoater clearance. Displacement shows the extent to which the part warps during the additive manufacturing process. Recoater clearance helps find potential print failures caused by interference between the recoater blade and the part being manufactured.

locale.message: 结果包括位移和涂覆机间隙。位移显示零件在增材制造过程中发生翘曲的程度。涂覆机间隙有助于查找涂覆机叶片与正在制造的零件之间的干涉导致的潜在打印故障。

message.name: The results include recoater clearance and displacement, which shows the extent to which the part warps during the additive manufacturing process. message.name: The stock material selected in a setup groups the matching tool presets for easier selection. Populate your libraries with stock materials to match what you have on the shop floor. message.name: The stock transfer strategy is intended for automatic stock transfer between the two spindles. No toolpath is associated with this strategy. The post is responsible for outputting the desired NC code.

message.name: The strategy first makes a series of constant Z-layers through the part, and then clears them in stages from the bottom upwards. Because it can cut so deeply, the first step down at each stage should be the effective cutting length of the tool. Then clearing of the intermediate layers proceeds into the shallower layers to maximize the efficiency of the tool use.

locale.message: 此加工策略会在模型的 Z 方向上生成一系列等值的平面，然后从底至上依次切削。因为切削会很深，所以往往第一次下刀，就会达到刀具能承受的最大深度。然后由深至浅，从而最大限度利用刀具。

message.name: The strategy offsets the specified floor surfaces to create the toolpath. This removes the stock effectively by not leaving behind any steps on the floor surface. You can also use ceiling surfaces to change the shape of the toolpath.

locale.message: 该策略会偏移指定的底面曲面来创建刀具路径。这样不会在底面曲面上留下任何阶梯，从而有效地移除毛坯。您也可以使用天花板曲面来改变刀具路径的形状。

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构在使用其他类型可能缺少支撑的区域中添加支撑，因此有助于确保零件得到正确支撑。支撑形成垂直杆，将零件连接到构建平台。将此结构类型与其他结构类型结合使用可增强零件的支撑。

message.name: This type of support structure enables a strong connection between the build platform and other support structures used on the part. They can help improve adhesion to, and reduce wear of, the build platform. Use this structure type with another to enhance the support of a part.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构支持在构建平台与零件上使用的其他支撑结构之间建立稳固的连接。它们有助于提高与构建平台的粘合性并减少构建平台的磨损。将此结构类型与其他结构类型结合使用可增强零件的支撑。

message.name: This type of support structure fills the volume under the selected areas, is typically strong, and is ideal for parts with large overhangs. The supports use a series of closed, hollow columns or a patterned styling that resembles cross-hatching. Use this structure type on its own or with another type.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构填充选定区域下的体积，通常很坚固，并且非常适合具有大悬垂的零件。支撑使用一系列闭合的空心柱或类似于交叉填充的阵列样式。单独使用此结构类型或将其与其他类型结合使用。

message.name: This type of support structure fills the volume under the selected areas, provides rigidity, and is ideal for parts with large overhangs. The supports form rods to create a scaffold-like structure, which can grow adaptively at the build platform. Use this structure type with another to enhance the support of a part.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构填充选定区域下的体积，提供刚性，并且非常适合具有大悬垂的零件。支撑形成杆以创建脚手架状结构，该结构可以在构建平台上自适应增长。将此结构类型与其他结构类型结合使用可增强零件的支撑。

message.name: This type of support structure forms an enveloping wall that traces the contour of a volume support. The walls can be featureless or use a patterned styling. Use this structure type with a volume support to enhance the support of a part.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构形成跟踪体积支撑轮廓的包裹壁。壁可以是无特征的，也可以使用阵列样式。将此结构类型与体积支撑结合使用可增强零件的支撑。

message.name: This type of support structure is easier to remove after the manufacturing process is complete and is ideal for intricate parts. The supports are straight walls that form parallel to each other and can be featureless or use a patterned styling. Use this structure type on its own or with another type.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构在制造过程完成后更易于删除，并且非常适合复杂零件。支撑是相互平行且可以无特征或使用阵列样式的直壁。单独使用此结构类型或将其与其他类型结合使用。

message.name: This type of support structure is for holding additively manufactured parts when placed in a furnace for sintering. Sintering is a secondary process used in some types of additive manufacturing, for example, binder jetting and metal FFF, where the deposited material is solidified and strengthened through the application of heat.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构用于在放入熔炉中进行烧结时容纳增材制造的零件。烧结是在某些增材制造类型(例如粘合剂喷射和金属 FFF)中使用的二次工艺，其中沉积的材料通过应用热量进行固化和强化。

message.name: This type of support structure is good for transferring heat away from parts to reduce potential deformation and is ideal for parts with small overhangs. The supports form vertical rods that connect the part to the build platform and they can join to form tree-like structures. Use this structure type on its own or with another type.

locale.message: 此类型的支撑结构适用于从零件移走热量以减少潜在变形，并且非常适合具有小悬垂的零件。支撑形成垂直杆，将零件连接到构建平台，并且它们可以联接以形成树状结构。单独此结构类型或将其与其他类型结合使用。

message.name: This vector does not have to be orthogonal to a major plane, for example, it could be [0,.7071, .7071]. The direction of the rotary axes is based on the right-hand rule for tables and the left-hand rule for heads.

locale.message: 此矢量不必与主平面正交，例如，它可能为 [0,.7071, .7071]。旋转轴的方向基于工作台的右手法则和头部的左手法则。

message.name: This vector doesn't need to be orthogonal to a major plane, for example it can be [0,.7071, .7071]. The direction of the rotary axes is based on the right-hand rule for tables, and the left-hand rule for heads.

locale.message: 此矢量不必与主平面正交，例如，它可以是 [0,.7071, .7071]。旋转轴的方向基于工作台的右手法则和头部的左手法则。

message.name: To avoid plunging, the tool ramps down along a helical path between levels. To maintain a high feedrate and reduce machining time, sharp changes of direction are avoided by smoothing the tool motion.

locale.message: 为避免下刀，刀具沿不同水平间的螺旋路径向下斜插。为维持高的进给速率并减小加工时间，可通过平滑刀具运动避免方向的急剧变化。

message.name: To be included with the %1 Extension

locale.message: 將包含在 %1 扩展程序中

message.name: To change the axis direction, specify a vector pointing in the opposite direction, that is [-1, 0, 0].

locale.message: 要更改轴方向，请指定指向相反方向(即 [-1, 0, 0])的矢量。

message.name: To edit a component's priority, ensure Priority Type is set to Component.

locale.message: 若要编辑零部件的优先级，请确保将“优先级类型”设置为“零部件”。

message.name: To get a continuous toolpath from one surface to another, ensure that the underlying isocurves of the surfaces align with each other and set the passes to run in the same isometric direction.

locale.message: 若要链接到文件夹，请在“已链接”文件夹上单击鼠标右键，然后单击“链接文件夹”。

message.name:
Uses the stock that is leftover to help visualize excess or gouged material. In most cases, the Leftover Stock value should be identical to the Stock to Leave value used for the operation that you are currently simulating.

The Leftover Stock is a positive or negative distance that is offset from the model's surface. A value of zero measures excess or gouged material from the model's surface.

In the image below, a Contour operation machines the sloped wall with a Stock to Leave value of 0.3 mm. The image on the left shows the simulated result with a Leftover Stock value of 0 mm, showing excess material. The image on the right shows the simulated result using a Leftover Stock value of 0.3 mm, indicating that the operation has removed the correct amount of stock.

locale.message:
使用剩余的毛坯以帮助可视化多余或过切材料。在大多数情况下，“剩余毛坯”值应与当前正在仿真的操作所使用的“加工余量”值相同。

“剩余毛坯”是自模型表面的正或负偏移距离。值为零时会从模型表面测量多余或过切材料。

在下图中，轮廓操作使用 0.3 毫米的“加工余量”值加工斜壁。左侧图像显示了“剩余毛坯”值为 0 毫米时的仿真结果，并显示了多余材料。右侧图像显示了“剩余毛坯”值为 0.3 毫米时的仿真结果，指示操作已去除正确的毛坯量。
使用 %1 中的 CAM 内核

message.name: Using Delete Passes to remove unwanted areas of a toolpath is quicker than trimming by placing points over a toolpath. This is because Delete Passes lets you select individual passes or segments.

locale.message: 使用“删除加工路径”删除不需要的刀具路径区域比通过在刀具路径上放置点进行修剪要快。这是因为“删除加工路径”允许您选择单独的路径或段。

message.name: Using this modification, you can add more efficiency and safety to your toolpaths by modifying things like the clearance area type, clearance heights, and changing the type of leads and links. You can also add smaller lead or link moves in places where the toolpath was not able to initially.

message.name: Volume support structures are best used for parts with large overhanging areas. The support mostly consists of a sparse zigzag pattern, with a denser top to improve the quality of the supported layer. A layer-by-layer animation of the support can be viewed when you simulate the additive toolpath.

locale.message: 体积支撑结构最适合具有大型悬垂区域的零件。支撑主要包含稀疏折线图案，具有更密集的顶部用于提高支撑层的质量。在仿真增材制造刀具路径时，可以查看支撑的逐层动画。

message.name: When deselected, and one or more inspection results are out of tolerance, the machine tool pauses, and Fusion prompts you to approve or reject the part alignment.

locale.message: 如果取消选择该选项，并且一个或多个检查结果超出公差范围，则机床将暂停，Fusion 会提示您批准或拒绝零件对齐。

message.name: When deselected, or if one or more inspection results are not in tolerance, the machine tool pauses, and Fusion prompts you to approve or reject the part alignment.

locale.message: 如果取消选择该选项或者一个或多个检查结果不在公差范围内，则机床将暂停，Fusion 会提示您批准或拒绝零件对齐。

message.name: When deselected, the deviation of a point is the shortest distance from the actual contact point to its nominal position, which might not be where the probe touches the part.

locale.message: 取消选择该选项后，点的偏差是从实际接触点到其公称位置的最短距离，这可能不是探头与零件接触的位置。

message.name: When enabled the axial offset is increased gradually from the initial axial offset to the axial offset with each stepdown.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，轴向偏移将随着每个下刀步距从初始轴向偏移逐渐增加到轴向偏移。

message.name: When enabled the tool will be retracted before moving over and inside cut.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，刀具在移开并进行内侧切削之前将会退刀。

message.name: When enabled, corner probing will be done with two probing points on each face

locale.message: 启用该选项后，将以每个面上两个探测点的方式完成转角探测

message.name: When enabled, cutting moves will be permitted to appoach from outside the back limit.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，将允许切削移动从后侧限界外进刀。

message.name: When enabled, cutting moves will be permitted to appoach from outside the front limit.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，将允许切削移动从前侧限界外进刀。

message.name: When enabled, linking moves will be permitted beyond the back limit.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，将允许连接移动超出后侧限界。

message.name: When enabled, linking moves will be permitted beyond the front limit.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，将允许连接移动超出前侧限界。

message.name: When enabled, prevents plunging during adaptive roughing

locale.message: 启用该选项后，可防止在自适应粗加工期间下刀

message.name: When enabled, ramps are started and ended tangentially in all three axes.

locale.message: 启用该项后，所有三个轴的斜坡加工都从切线方向开始和结束。

message.name: When enabled, the probe position will be based on the clicked position on the selected face.

locale.message: 启用该选项后，探头位置将基于选定面上的单击位置。

message.name: When fluctuations of the rotary axes are insignificant, this limit prevents adjustment of the tool axis vector. Typically set to 10 degrees or more.

locale.message: 当旋转轴的波动不明显时，此限制会阻止调整刀具轴矢量。通常设置为 10 度或更大。

message.name: When ordering by area, this setting controls the number of passes that are buffered during the process. Using a smaller number may lead to a less optimal order, while using a larger number may slow down the calculation.

locale.message: 按区域排序时，此设置控制加工过程中缓冲的加工路径数。数值较小可能导致排序结果非最优，数值较大则可能降低计算速度。

message.name: When programming, you can target either walls or floors. The strategy automatically uses a suitable contact point on the tool, but you can manually specify a contact point with a minimum and maximum range to reach smaller corners or have smoother rotary motion.

locale.message: 编程时，可以将壁或楼板作为目标。加工策略会自动在刀具上使用合适的接触点，但您可以手动指定具有最小和最大范围的接触点，以实现更小的拐角或更平滑的旋转运动。

message.name: When recording the manual inspection, you can show the model as it was when the snapshot was created.

locale.message: 记录手动检查时，可以显示创建快照时的模型。

message.name: When selected, and if all the inspection results are in tolerance, Fusion automatically approves the part alignment without pausing the machine tool.

locale.message: 如果选择了该选项，并且所有检查结果均在公差范围内，则 Fusion 将自动批准零件对齐，而不会暂停机床。

message.name: When selected, and if one or more inspection results are out of tolerance, Fusion automatically rejects the part alignment and stops the machine tool.

locale.message: 如果选择了该选项，并且一个或多个检查结果超出公差，则 Fusion 将自动拒绝零件对齐并停止机床。

message.name: When selected, Fusion automatically finds and select the bodies on which the points were specified and projects the inspection results onto those bodies.

locale.message: 选择该选项后，Fusion 会自动查找并选择在其上指定点的实体，并将检查结果投影到这些实体上。

message.name: When selected, Fusion imports all results from the selected file instead of just the results from the last START onward.

locale.message: 选择该选项后，Fusion 将从选定文件导入所有结果，而不仅仅是自最后一个 START 以后的结果。

message.name: When selected, the deviation of a point is the distance from the actual contact point to a point projected onto the nearest nominal CAD surface. The projected point is based on a calculation of where the probe touches the part's surface, which makes the results more accurate.

locale.message: 选择该选项后，点的偏差是从实际接触点到投影到最近公称 CAD 表面上的点的距离。投影点基于探头与零件表面接触的位置的计算，这使结果更精确。

message.name: When selected, the subspindle's Z axis is in the opposite direction to that of the main spindle's Z axis. When deselected, the subspindle's Z axis is in the same direction as the main spindle's Z axis.

locale.message: 选择该选项后，副主轴的 Z 轴与主轴的 Z 轴方向相反。取消选择该选项后，副主轴的 Z 轴与主轴的 Z 轴方向相同。

message.name: When using Fusion for Personal Use, you cannot post process operations that contain tool changes in a single NC file.\nPost processing with tool changes is available with a Fusion Subscription.\nTo continue with Fusion for Personal Use, post a separate NC file for each group of operations machined by the same tool.

locale.message: 使用个人版 Fusion 时，无法后处理单个 NC 文件中的包含换刀的操作。\n在 Fusion 订购版中可以后处理换刀。\n若要继续使用个人版 Fusion，请对使用同一刀具加工的每一组操作的单个 NC 文件进行后处理。

message.name: When using Fusion for Personal Use, you cannot post process operations that contain tool changes in a single NC program.\nPost processing with tool changes is available with a Fusion Subscription.\nTo continue with Fusion for Personal Use, create a separate NC program for each group of operations machined by the same tool.

locale.message: 使用个人版 Fusion 时，无法后处理单个 NC 程序中的包含换刀的操作。\n在 Fusion 订购版中可以后处理换刀。\n若要继续使用个人版 Fusion，请为使用同一刀具加工的每一组操作创建一个 NC 程序。

message.name: When using open curves, the tool can lead-in with smooth movements between passes. When using closed curves, the strategy can generate a continuous spiral toolpath, which can reduce cycle time and provide a better surface finish.

locale.message: 使用开放曲线时，刀具可以通过在加工路径之间平滑移动而导入。使用闭合曲线时，策略可以生成连续的螺旋刀具路径，这可以缩短周期时间并提供更好的曲面光洁度。

message.name: When using the command, sketch a line to intersect the closed passes at the desired new entry positions.

locale.message: 使用该命令时，请绘制一条直线，以在所需的新进刀位置与闭合加工路径相交。

message.name: When you click on an NC Program in the Browser, the toolpaths that are in that NC Program are displayed in the canvas.

locale.message: 当您在浏览器中单击 NC 程序时，该 NC 程序中的刀具路径会显示在画布中。

message.name: When you obtain the measured value, in the Browser, select the Manual Inspection entry, and then click Inspect > Record Manual Inspection to record the value.

locale.message: 获取测量值后，在浏览器中选择“手动检查”条目，然后单击“检查”>“记录手动检查”即可记录该值。

message.name: Whether a centreline is calculated for the toolpath or not.

locale.message: 是否为刀具路径计算中心线。

message.name: Whether using single or multiple passes, this strategy is ideally suited for cleaning up after other finishing strategies.

locale.message: 无论使用单个还是多个加工路径，该加工策略都是使用精加工策略后进行清洁的理想选择。

message.name: White: Stock not yet scheduled for generation.

locale.message: 白色: 毛坯尚未计划进行生成。

message.name: Width of a chip breaker measured at the mid-point of its length

locale.message: 在断屑器长度的中点处测量的断屑器的宽度

message.name: Width of the cut made by the cutting item(s) as it (they) penetrates into the work surface.

locale.message: 切削项穿透工作曲面时所进行的切削的宽度。

message.name: Width of the main functional portion of a cylindrical object

locale.message: 圆柱形对象的主功能部分的宽度

message.name: Width of the portion of the cutting item which is mounted on the tool item

locale.message: 装配在刀具项上的切削项部分的宽度

message.name: With the current tool and method for calculating stepovers, Clearance Geometry must be a plane whose direction is set from the Tool Orientation Z. To use a different type of clearance geometry, select a ball-ended cutter that is not tapered, or calculate stepovers relative to the tip of the tool.

locale.message: 使用当前刀具和计算步距的方法时，间隙几何图元必须是从刀具朝向 Z 设置设置方向的平面。若要使用其他类型的间隙几何图元，请选择非锥形的球头刀具，或相对于刀尖计算步距。

message.name: With the current tool, Clearance Geometry must be a plane whose direction is set from the Tool Orientation Z. To use a different type of clearance geometry, select a ball-ended cutter that is not tapered.

locale.message: 使用当前刀具时，间隙几何图元必须是从刀具朝向 Z 设置方向的平面。若要使用其他类型的间隙几何图元，请选择非锥形的球头刀具。

message.name: With the selected options for multi-axis machining, radial and axial clearances on the machined surfaces must be equal.

locale.message: 选择多轴加工选项后，加工曲面上的径向和轴向间隙必须相等。

message.name: With the selected options for multi-axis machining, radial and axial stock to leave must be equal.

locale.message: 使用多轴加工的选定选项时，径向和轴向加工余量必须相等。

message.name: Within the Machine Builder, you can adjust the axis direction of selected components, aligning them precisely with the coordinate system. Assign components and define attachment points to accurately represent the linear, rotary, and static aspects of the machine. And interactively jog the axes to visually verify that the machine model moves in a manner consistent with your physical CNC machine.

locale.message: 在机床生成器中，您可以调整选定零部件的轴方向，使其与坐标系精确对齐。指定零部件并定义附着点来准确表示机床的线性、旋转和静态方面。以交互方式微调轴来直观地验证机床模型的移动方式是否与物理 CNC 机床一致。

locale.message: 是否要在没有任何限制的情况下继续后处理？

locale.message: 是否要在不使用机床的情况下进行仿真？

locale.message: 环绕刀具路径不能应用于包含刀具路径修改的刀具路径。

message.name: You are currently offline, which prevents you from selecting a machine model to link to this machine definition. Check your Internet connection and try again.

locale.message: 您当前处于脱机状态，这使您无法选择要链接到此机床定义的机床模型。请检查您的 Internet 连接，然后重试。

message.name: You are referencing a geometry selection from an operation that uses a different tool orientation than the current operation.\n\nChange the tool orientation of the current operation to match the geometry selection you are referencing or use a different geometry selection.

locale.message: 您正在参考使用与当前操作不同的刀具朝向的操作中选择的形状。\n\n请更改当前操作的刀具朝向以与您选择要参考的形状匹配，或者使用选择的其他形状。

message.name: You are trying to create an NC Program for Setups containing Part Alignments that are not calculated.

locale.message: 您正在尝试为之创建 NC 程序的“设置”中包含未计算的零件对齐。

message.name: You are using a post processor from the Fusion Library. Post processors stored here receive automatic updates. You must use a post processor stored in My Posts.\n\nChoose a My Posts location and then click Copy to My Posts.

locale.message: 您正在使用 Fusion 库中的后处理器。存储在此处的后处理器将接收自动更新。您必须使用存储在“我的后处理器”中的后处理器。\n\n选择“我的后处理器”位置，然后单击“复制到‘我的后处理器’”。

message.name: You can also machine parts that have spiralled walls to a high-quality surface finish.

locale.message: 您还可以加工具有螺旋壁的零件以实现高质量的表面光洁度。

message.name: You can change the axis direction by supplying a vector pointing in the opposite direction, that is [0, 0, -1].

locale.message: 您可以通过提供指向相反方向(即 [0, 0, -1])的矢量来更改轴方向。

message.name: You can choose multiple roughing and finishing passes and multiple depth cuts for any contour.

locale.message: 可针对任何轮廓选择多个粗加工和精加工路径以及分层铣深切削。

message.name: You can choose to check selected components. If no components are selected, all components in the active setup are checked.

locale.message: 可以选择检查选定的零部件。如果未选择任何零部件，则将检查激活设置中的所有零部件。

message.name: You can create separate folders for roughing, semi-finishing, and finishing operations.

locale.message: 可以为粗加工、半精加工和精加工操作创建独立的文件夹。

message.name: You can generate a 3-, 4-, or 5-axis swarf toolpath depending on the shape of the geometry and your machine's capabilities.

locale.message: 您可以根据几何图元的形状和机床的功能生成 3 轴、4 轴或 5 轴刀具侧刃加工刀具路径。

message.name: You can generate a 3-, 4-, or 5-axis toolpath depending on the shape of the geometry and your machine's capabilities.

locale.message: 您可以根据形状和机床的功能生成 3 轴、4 轴或 5 轴刀具路径。

message.name: You can generate a 3-, 4-, or 5-axis toolpath depending on your machine's capabilities. Collisions are automatically avoided using shaft and holder clearances.

locale.message: 您可以根据机床的功能生成 3 轴、4 轴或 5 轴刀具路径。使用轴和夹头间隙可自动避免碰撞。

message.name: You can move the entry positions so that the tool does not enter the part where there is heavy material engagement, such as internal corners for example. You can also stagger the entry positions to avoid dwell marks on the part. Lastly, you can move the entry positions to a place where the tool entry is visible to the operator for safer machining.

locale.message: 您可以移动进刀位置，使刀具不进入存在大量材料啮合的零件(例如内部转角)。您还可以交错进刀位置，以避免在零件上留下痕迹。最后，您可以将进刀位置移动到操作员可以看到刀具进刀的位置，以便更安全地进行加工。

message.name: You can only create one Additive Arrange in a setup.

locale.message: 在设置中只能创建一个增材排列。

message.name: You can only create one Datum item in a setup.

locale.message: 您只能在设置中创建一个基准项目。

message.name: You can only create one Part Alignment in a setup.

locale.message: 您只能在设置中创建一个零件对齐。

message.name: You can place the copies in various ways. Place them at the same location as the original components so you can manually move them later. Alternatively, distribute them evenly along a single axis or space them out along multiple axes for efficient arrangement.

locale.message: 您可以通过各种方式放置副本。将它们放置在与原始零部件相同的位置，以便以后可以手动移动它们。或者，使其沿单个轴均匀分布，也可以使其沿多个轴分散开来以实现高效排列。

message.name: You can select one or more entry positions, which lets you specify the end of the slot in which to plunge.

locale.message: 可以选择一个或多个进刀位置，然后指定下刀的窄槽端。

message.name: You can use the Save As dialog instead of specifying the file name and output folder in the Settings page of the NC Program.

locale.message: 您可以使用“另存为”对话框，而不是在 NC 程序的“设置”页面中指定文件名和输出文件夹。

message.name: You cannot clear the toolpath of protected operations.

locale.message: 不能清除受保护操作的刀具路径。

message.name: You cannot delete the active Part Alignment while in Part Alignment Mode.

locale.message: 在“零件对齐”模式下无法删除活动的零件对齐。

message.name: You cannot edit a setup containing an imported toolpath.

locale.message: 您无法编辑包含导入的刀具路径的设置。

message.name: You have a boundary that is not closed. A closed boundary consists of three or more points.\n\nClick on any existing points on the boundary to activate it then place more points.

locale.message: 您有未闭合的边界。闭合边界由三个或更多点组成。\n\n单击边界上的任意现有点以将其激活，然后放置更多点。

message.name: You have a Personal license (for non-commercial use only).\nYou only have Basic Access to data while you are in this hub.

locale.message: 您拥有个人许可(仅限非商业用途)。\n在此中心中，您只有对数据的基本访问权限。

message.name: You have a Personal license (for non-commercial use only).\nYou only have Basic Access to data while you are in this Project.

locale.message: 您拥有个人许可(仅限非商业用途)。\n在此项目中，您只有对数据的基本访问权限。

message.name: You have cancelled the live connection between Fusion and the Machine Connector application.

locale.message: 您已取消 Fusion 和机床连接器应用程序之间的实时连接。

message.name: You have changed the default spindle rotation. Ensure the spindle rotates towards the insert on the tool to prevent damage.

locale.message: 您已更改默认主轴旋转。请确保主轴朝刀具上的镶件旋转，以防止损坏。

message.name: You have chosen to override all \"user-defined\" parameter values to their defaults. You cannot undo this action. Are you sure you want to do this?

locale.message: 您已选择将所有 \"用户定义的\" 参数值覆盖为其默认值。您无法撤消此操作。是否确实要执行此操作？

message.name: You likely need to change the 'Machining Type' to be something other than 'Polar'.

locale.message: 您可能需要将“加工类型”更改为“极轴”以外的类型。

message.name: You likely need to change the 'Machining type' to be something other than 3-axis.

locale.message: 您可能需要将“加工类型”更改为 3 轴以外的类型。

message.name: You likely need to change the 'Primary mode' to be something other than 'Tilt and lead'.

locale.message: 您可能需要将“主模式”更改为“倾斜和引导”以外的模式。

message.name: You likely need to change the tool tip to be spherical.

locale.message: 您可能需要将刀尖更改为球形。

You likely need to choose 'Face profiling'.

locale.message: 您可能需要选择“面轮廓加工”。

locale.message: 您可能需要选择“内开槽”。

locale.message: 您可能需要禁用“在刀具上的固定点处切削”。

locale.message: 您可能需要启用“在刀具上的固定点处切削”。

locale.message: 您无法编辑具有受保护操作的孔识别。\n是否要取消对操作的保护？

message.name: You may not edit a protected operation.\nDo you want to remove the protection from the operation and continue editing?

locale.message: 您不能编辑受保护的操作。\n是否要从操作中删除保护并继续编辑？

message.name: You may override this, and specify a program of your choice, in Preferences -> Manufacture -> External editor.

locale.message: 您可以覆盖此项，然后在“首选项”->“制造”->“外部编辑器”中指定选择的程序。

message.name: You most likely intend to generate the NC program for each machine independently. A single NC program will be generated unless your post has been configured specifically for handling multi-machine processing.

locale.message: 您很可能倾向于针对每个机床生成单独的 NC 程序。除非您特别针对多机床处理对后处理进行了配置，否则会生成单个 NC 程序。

message.name: You must allow translations along at least one axis.

locale.message: 必须允许沿至少一个轴进行平移。

message.name: You must Solve before you can view the Results \n Please use the Pre-Check tool for guidance

locale.message: 您必须先求解，然后才能查看结果\n请使用预检查工具获取指导

locale.message: 您需要选择要导入的结果文件

locale.message: 您需要重新打开对话框以应用此值。是否要继续？

message.name: Your computer will be used to perform the process. Ensure that there are at least two elements through the thinnest cross-section of the mesh. A three-part mesh study is required to prove mesh convergence.

locale.message: 您的计算机将用于执行该过程。请确保至少有两个元素穿过网格的最薄横截面。要证明网格收敛，需要进行三部分网格分析。
